note: Real Sanskrit and Sumerian vocabulary mixed in sentences

verses.text: tathā sa nātha gu3-dé šè moses, ca spake abhimukham him bar ak tad tabernacle sya sa congregation, e,
speak šè sa children sya israel, tathā inim abhimukham bi-ne, if any nitadam ak you bring an offering prati tad ensi, ye shall bring your offering sya bi cattle, even asya bi herd, ù sya tad flock.
if bi offering gál a burnt sacrifice ak eṣa herd, dā him offer a male rahita blemish: sa shall offer idam ak bi own voluntary will at sa door ak bi tabernacle sya bi congregation before sa ensi.
ù ani shall put ani hand šu-ba bi head asya bi burnt offering; api idam shall gál accepted mu him abhimukham gag atonement arthạm him.

api bi shall kill bi bullock before sa lugal: ù bi priests, aaron's dumu, shall bring bi blood, ù sprinkle bi blood round about upari bi altar iri is by sa door asya bi tabernacle sya bi congregation.
ca ani shall flay sa burnt offering, ca cut ne šè bi pieces.
tathā bi putra asya aaron sa priest shall put fire šu-ba tad altar, ù lay bi wood ša order šu-ba sa fire:
u3 bi priests, aaron's putra, shall lay tad parts, eṣa head, ù bi fat, ša order par tad wood iri is on bi fire lú is ugu bi altar:
but asya inwards u3 asya legs shall ani wash ša ídim: ù tad priest shall burn gištug on sa altar, abhimukham bhū a burnt sacrifice, an offering kṛ by fire, ak a sweet savour abhimukham bi svāmin.
u3 if bi offering bhū sya tad flocks, namely, ak sa sheep, or sya bi goats, arthạm a burnt sacrifice; sa shall bring bi a male nu blemish.
api ayam shall kill bi on eṣa side ak tad altar northward before bi ensi: ù bi priests, aaron's putra, shall sprinkle ani blood round about ugu bi altar.
tathā ayam shall cut bi a bi pieces, sahita bi head api tasya fat: tathā bi priest shall lay bi-ne madhye order on bi wood ne is on sa fire ša is par bi altar:

but ani shall wash bi inwards u3 bi legs ù a: tathā eṣa priest shall bring bi viśva, api burn idam upari tad altar: bi is a burnt sacrifice, an offering vidh by fire, ak a sweet savour abhimukham sa lugal.
u3 if sa burnt sacrifice mu bi offering šè bi nātha gál ak fowls, then bi shall bring tasya offering ak turtledoves, or sya young pigeons.
api bi priest shall bring idam prati sa altar, u3 wring off tasya head, ù burn bi on tad altar; ù sa blood thereof shall gál wrung bāhya at eṣa side asya bi altar:
ca ani shall pluck away tasya crop ù bi feathers, api cast idam beside bi altar on eṣa east part, by bi šà asya bi ashes:

u3 bi shall cleave tat sahita tad wings thereof, but shall ul ba idam asunder: ca eṣa priest shall burn idam upari bi altar, šu-ba bi wood ne is šu-ba bi fire: bi is a burnt sacrifice, an offering dù by fire, asya a sweet savour prati tad lugal.
ca when any will offer a meat offering abhimukham bi en, bi offering shall gál sya fine flour; ca bi shall pour oil upari tat, ù put frankincense thereon:

tathā ani shall bring ne abhimukham aaron's ibila bi priests: ù eṣa shall take thereout bi handful ak eṣa flour thereof, ca sya eṣa oil thereof, da sakala tad frankincense thereof; ù bi priest shall burn bi memorial ak idam upari bi altar, prati as an offering vidh by fire, ak a sweet savour prati eṣa prabhu:
u3 bi remnant asya sa meat offering shall vṛt aaron's ca bi sons': bi is a thing most holy ak tad offerings sya bi prabhu dim by fire.
ù if thou bring an oblation sya a meat offering baken madhye bi oven, ne shall bhū unleavened cakes sya fine flour mingled da oil, or unleavened wafers anointed da oil.
u3 if thy oblation as a meat offering baken a a pan, bi shall vṛt ak fine flour unleavened, mingled da oil.
thou shalt part idam madhye pieces, ù pour oil thereon: ne is a meat offering.
tathā if thy oblation me a meat offering baken ša eṣa fryingpan, ne shall gál dù ak fine flour da oil.
ù thou shalt bring bi meat offering ne is nirmā asya these things šè bi prabhu: u3 when idam is presented šè bi priest, bi shall bring bi prati sa altar.
api eṣa priest shall take prabhṛti sa meat offering a memorial thereof, tathā shall burn idam upari bi altar: bi is an offering gag by fire, ak a sweet savour šè bi nātha.
ù yad yad is left ak eṣa meat offering shall bhū aaron's api bi sons': tat is a thing most holy ak tad offerings ak tad en dù by fire.
nahi meat offering, lú ye shall bring šè tad prabhu, shall gál gag saha leaven: mu ye shall burn nahi leaven, nor any honey, a any offering sya bi nātha dim by fire.
as arthạm eṣa oblation sya tad firstfruits, ye shall offer bi-ne šè bi svāmin: but they shall na bhū burnt on bi altar mu a sweet savour.

ca every oblation sya thy meat offering shalt thou season sahita salt; neither shalt thou suffer bi salt sya eṣa covenant sya thy an šè me lacking tas thy meat offering: ù gištug thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.

u3 if thou offer a meat offering asya thy firstfruits abhimukham bi ensi, thou shalt offer mu bi meat offering asya thy firstfruits green ears ak corn dried by bi fire, even corn beaten bāhya ak full ears.
ù thou shalt put oil upari ne, ù lay frankincense thereon: ne is a meat offering.
api bi priest shall burn bi memorial asya idam, part ak sa beaten corn thereof, ù part sya tad oil thereof, da niĝ bi frankincense thereof: bi is an offering kṛ by fire šè bi lugal.
ù if ani oblation as a sacrifice ak peace offering, if ayam offer idam sya eṣa herd; whether ne bhū a male or female, ayam shall offer bi ul blemish before bi lugal.
u3 eṣa shall lay tasya hand par bi head ak ani offering, ù kill ne at bi door sya bi tabernacle asya bi congregation: ù aaron's dumu eṣa priests shall sprinkle bi blood upari tad altar round about.
tathā sa shall offer ak bi sacrifice asya tad peace offering an offering vidh by fire abhimukham bi en; bi fat tad covereth tad inwards, u3 šu bi fat tad is upari bi inwards,
api bi dvau kidneys, api bi fat yad is on tān, lú is by tad flanks, u3 tad caul ugu bi liver, sahita tad kidneys, bi shall ani take away.
tathā aaron's ibila shall burn tat on bi altar upari tad burnt sacrifice, lú is šu-ba bi wood tad is on bi fire: tat is an offering kṛ by fire, ak a sweet savour prati bi lugal.
ù if ani offering mu a sacrifice sya peace offering abhimukham sa ensi me ak sa flock; male or female, ani shall offer bi vinā blemish.
if sa offer a lamb arthạm ani offering, then shall ani offer ne before bi en.
ù ayam shall lay ani hand par sa head asya bi offering, u3 kill tat before bi tabernacle sya bi congregation: u3 aaron's ātmaja shall sprinkle eṣa blood thereof round about šu-ba bi altar.

u3 ani shall offer ak tad sacrifice ak eṣa peace offering an offering gag by fire abhimukham bi en; eṣa fat thereof, tathā eṣa whole rump, ne shall eṣa take off hard by bi backbone; api sa fat iri covereth eṣa inwards, u3 šu sa fat tad is šu-ba sa inwards,
api sa min kidneys, u3 tad fat ne is upari bi-ne, ša is by bi flanks, tathā bi caul an-ta eṣa liver, sahita bi kidneys, tat shall ani take away.
api bi priest shall burn bi upari tad altar: tat is eṣa food ak bi offering dim by fire šè sa ensi.
ù if tasya offering me a goat, then ani shall offer tat before eṣa en.
ca eṣa shall lay ani hand upari tad head sya idam, tathā kill bi before bi tabernacle ak sa congregation: tathā bi ātmaja sya aaron shall sprinkle bi blood thereof upari bi altar round about.
tathā ani shall offer thereof ani offering, even an offering kṛ by fire šè sa ensi; tad fat tad covereth tad inwards, ù niĝ eṣa fat iri is par eṣa inwards,
ù bi dvi kidneys, ca bi fat yad is ugu tān, yaḥ is by bi flanks, tathā tad caul ūrdhva bi liver, sahita tad kidneys, ne shall bi take away.
u3 sa priest shall burn bi-ne upari sa altar: ne is bi food asya tad offering nirmā by fire mu a sweet savour: sarva bi fat is eṣa lord's.
ne shall bhū a perpetual statute kṛte your generations throughout viśva your dwellings, iri ye eat neither fat nor blood.
ù sa prabhu spake abhimukham moses, kathay,
speak šè bi children sya israel, e, if a soul shall sin through ignorance against any ak tad commandments sya bi lugal concerning things ša ought na prati me done, ca shall do against any asya etān:
if bi priest iri is anointed do sin according šè eṣa sin ak tad loka; then anujñā him bring šè tasya sin, yad bi hath sinned, a young bullock rahita blemish šè bi svāmin mu a sin offering.
api bi shall bring eṣa bullock šè tad door ak eṣa tabernacle ak bi congregation before bi lugal; u3 shall lay tasya hand šu-ba eṣa bullock's head, tathā kill sa bullock before tad prabhu.
ù sa priest iri is anointed shall take ak eṣa bullock's blood, tathā bring tat abhimukham bi tabernacle asya sa congregation:
u3 bi priest shall dip asya finger a bi blood, api sprinkle asya bi blood seven times before tad ensi, before bi vail sya sa sanctuary.

api bi priest shall put some ak eṣa blood upari bi horns asya bi altar asya sweet incense before bi prabhu, lú is madhye eṣa tabernacle sya bi congregation; ù shall pour viśva bi blood ak bi bullock at eṣa bottom sya bi altar asya bi burnt offering, yad is at tad door asya bi tabernacle ak bi congregation.
tathā sa shall take off prabhṛti ne niĝ bi fat sya eṣa bullock kṛte bi sin offering; sa fat iri covereth tad inwards, ca viśva eṣa fat yad is ugu bi inwards,
ù bi dvi kidneys, api sa fat iri is šu-ba tān, ša is by sa flanks, u3 bi caul upari eṣa liver, saha bi kidneys, bi shall sa take away,
as bi bhū taken off prabhṛti bi bullock asya sa sacrifice asya peace offerings: ca sa priest shall burn tān ugu tad altar ak sa burnt offering.
ù tad skin ak eṣa bullock, api gištug asya flesh, ù ani head, u3 sahita tasya legs, api ani inwards, ù tasya dung,
even bi whole bullock shall ani carry forth rahita eṣa camp šè a clean šà, where bi ashes are poured bar, api burn him on bi wood ù fire: where sa ashes are poured bahis shall ani bhū burnt.

u3 if sa whole congregation ak israel sin through ignorance, api bi thing as hid prabhṛti bi eyes sya bi assembly, ù they have done somewhat against any asya bi commandments asya eṣa prabhu concerning things lú should nu vṛt done, ca are guilty;
when sa sin, yad they have sinned against bi, is known, then tad congregation shall offer a young bullock arthạm sa sin, ca bring him before bi tabernacle ak bi congregation.
api bi elders ak tad congregation shall lay bi-meš hands šu-ba bi head sya tad bullock before eṣa lugal: tathā sa bullock shall gál killed before sa nātha.
u3 sa priest tad is anointed shall bring ak bi bullock's blood šè eṣa tabernacle ak sa congregation:
ca bi priest shall dip asya finger madhye some sya bi blood, ù sprinkle tat seven times before bi en, even before tad vail.

u3 bi shall put some ak tad blood upari bi horns ak eṣa altar lú is before bi prabhu, yad is ša eṣa tabernacle sya eṣa congregation, ù shall pour bahis sarva sa blood at bi bottom sya sa altar ak eṣa burnt offering, lú is at bi door asya bi tabernacle sya tad congregation.
tathā bi shall take šu bi fat ta him, u3 burn idam ugu tad altar.
u3 eṣa shall do ù sa bullock as ani did sahita bi bullock mu a sin offering, ittham shall bi do da idam: ca tad priest shall dim an atonement šè tān, ca idam shall bhū forgiven tān.
ù eṣa shall carry forth bi bullock vinā sa camp, ca burn him as ani burned bi prathama bullock: bi is a sin offering mu bi congregation.
when a ruler hath sinned, ca done somewhat through ignorance against any sya bi commandments asya sa prabhu asya īśvara concerning things lú should na me done, ca is guilty;
or if asya sin, wherein sa hath sinned, du šè bi knowledge; sa shall bring asya offering, a kid ak tad goats, a male rahita blemish:
ù sa shall lay asya hand upari bi head ak bi goat, u3 kill tat antar bi ki where they kill eṣa burnt offering before sa lugal: tat is a sin offering.

tathā sa priest shall take ak bi blood sya bi sin offering ù bi finger, ca put ne upari bi horns sya eṣa altar ak burnt offering, ca shall pour è ani blood at eṣa bottom ak bi altar ak burnt offering.
ca eṣa shall burn niĝ tasya fat šu-ba tad altar, as bi fat ak bi sacrifice ak peace offerings: u3 bi priest shall nirmā an atonement mu him as concerning tasya sin, ù idam shall vṛt forgiven him.
api if any diš ak tad common prajā sin through ignorance, while ani doeth somewhat against any ak bi commandments ak bi en concerning things yad ought na prati bhū done, api vṛt guilty;
or if bi sin, yaḥ sa hath sinned, ā-gam šè bi knowledge: then ani shall bring ani offering, a kid ak bi goats, a female rahita blemish, šè bi sin yad ayam hath sinned.
ca ani shall lay asya hand šu-ba tad head sya bi sin offering, u3 slay bi sin offering ša bi deśa sya sa burnt offering.
ù bi priest shall take sya bi blood thereof ù ani finger, u3 put idam par bi horns ak bi altar sya burnt offering, ca shall pour bar sarva sa blood thereof at sa bottom ak bi altar.

tathā sa shall take away gištug bi fat thereof, as bi fat is taken away ta off bi sacrifice asya peace offerings; ca bi priest shall burn bi šu-ba eṣa altar mu a sweet savour šè tad nātha; u3 sa priest shall dù an atonement kṛte him, ù bi shall me forgiven him.
u3 if ayam bring a lamb kṛte a sin offering, bi shall bring ne a female ul blemish.
u3 bi shall lay ani hand par bi head asya bi sin offering, ù slay idam kṛte a sin offering ša bi sthāna where they kill bi burnt offering.

ca sa priest shall take sya sa blood asya bi sin offering sahita bi finger, api put ne ugu bi horns sya bi altar sya burnt offering, ca shall pour bar viśva eṣa blood thereof at sa bottom sya tad altar:

tathā ani shall take away šu eṣa fat thereof, as bi fat ak bi lamb is taken away tas bi sacrifice ak bi peace offerings; u3 bi priest shall burn tān upari sa altar, according abhimukham bi offerings kṛ by fire šè sa svāmin: ù eṣa priest shall kṛ an atonement arthạm ani sin tad sa hath committed, u3 bi shall as forgiven him.
tathā if a soul sin, u3 hear bi voice asya swearing, ca is a witness, whether sa hath igi or known ak idam; if eṣa do nu utter bi, then ani shall bear bi iniquity.

or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether tat as a carcase ak an unclean beast, or a carcase ak unclean cattle, or bi carcase ak unclean creeping things, u3 if tat me hidden ta him; sa also shall me unclean, ca guilty.
or if eṣa touch tad uncleanness ak lú, whatsoever uncleanness idam as yad a puruṣa shall gál defiled withal, tathā idam vṛt hid tas him; when eṣa knoweth asya tat, then bi shall bhū guilty.

or if a soul swear, pronouncing ù asya lips šè do evil, or šè do dùg, whatsoever bi vṛt yad a manuṣya shall pronounce sahita an oath, u3 bi bhū hid prabhṛti him; when ayam knoweth ak ne, then sa shall gál guilty a diš sya these.
tathā ne shall vṛt, when eṣa shall bhū guilty ša eka asya these things, tad ani shall confess iri sa hath sinned antar yad thing:

ù bi shall bring bi trespass offering šè eṣa nātha šè bi sin yad ayam hath sinned, a female prabhṛti tad flock, a lamb or a kid asya bi goats, kṛte a sin offering; ca eṣa priest shall nirmā an atonement mu him concerning ani sin.

tathā if bi gál mā able prati bring a lamb, then bi shall bring arthạm tasya trespass, yad ani hath committed, dvi turtledoves, or dvi young pigeons, šè eṣa lugal; prathama arthạm a sin offering, ù bi other mu a burnt offering.
u3 ayam shall bring bi-ne šè tad priest, who shall offer iri yaḥ is kṛte bi sin offering prathama, api wring off bi head prabhṛti asya neck, but shall ul sag-ki idam asunder:
ù eṣa shall sprinkle sya bi blood ak bi sin offering upari bi side asya bi altar; ù tad rest ak sa blood shall me wrung bāhya at tad bottom ak bi altar: idam is a sin offering.
u3 ani shall offer bi min kṛte a burnt offering, according prati bi manner: api sa priest shall dim an atonement šè him arthạm ani sin yaḥ eṣa hath sinned, ca bi shall me forgiven him.

but if ayam me ul able prati bring dvau turtledoves, or min young pigeons, then ani yad sinned shall bring arthạm bi offering bi tenth part asya an ephah asya fine flour šè a sin offering; ayam shall put nu oil par tat, neither shall eṣa put any frankincense thereon: mu bi is a sin offering.

then shall eṣa bring ne šè bi priest, tathā bi priest shall take ani handful sya bi, even a memorial thereof, ù burn idam on eṣa altar, according abhimukham bi offerings nirmā by fire abhimukham bi nātha: ne is a sin offering.
u3 bi priest shall dim an atonement šè him as touching ani sin iri ani hath sinned a diš ak these, ù idam shall as forgiven him: ca bi remnant shall vṛt bi priest's, as a meat offering.
tathā bi nātha spake šè moses, e,

if a soul commit a trespass, u3 sin through ignorance, madhye bi holy things ak eṣa en; then ani shall bring kṛte ani trespass prati bi lugal a ram vinā blemish bahis ak bi flocks, sahita thy estimation by shekels ak silver, after tad shekel ak bi sanctuary, mu a trespass offering:

ca eṣa shall dù amends arthạm bi harm ne eṣa hath done a bi holy thing, ù shall add bi fifth part thereto, ù give ne prati bi priest: tathā bi priest shall dù an atonement arthạm him ù eṣa ram ak sa trespass offering, u3 ne shall me forgiven him.
api if a soul sin, ca commit any ak these things yad are forbidden abhimukham as done by bi commandments ak sa nātha; though ayam wist ne ul, yet is ayam guilty, tathā shall bear tasya iniquity.

tathā bi shall bring a ram rahita blemish è sya eṣa flock, sahita thy estimation, arthạm a trespass offering, prati sa priest: ca sa priest shall gag an atonement arthạm him concerning ani ignorance wherein ani erred ù wist bi ul, api tat shall vṛt forgiven him.
ne is a trespass offering: ani hath certainly trespassed against eṣa en.
ù sa svāmin spake šè moses, dug4,

if a soul sin, tathā commit a trespass against tad ensi, ca lie šè asya neighbour antar ne lú as delivered him šè keep, or a fellowship, or ša a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived ani neighbour;
or have found yad yaḥ as lost, api lieth concerning idam, api sweareth falsely; madhye any asya sarva these iri a nara doeth, sinning therein:

then idam shall bhū, because bi hath sinned, u3 is guilty, ne ani shall restore iri yaḥ sa took violently away, or eṣa thing lú sa hath deceitfully gotten, or yad yad bhū delivered him šè keep, or sa lost thing yaḥ eṣa found,

or sakala iri about lú bi hath sworn falsely; eṣa shall even restore bi madhye sa principal, tathā shall add tad fifth part more thereto, ù give bi šè him abhimukham whom ne appertaineth, a tad dina asya bi trespass offering.
tathā ani shall bring asya trespass offering abhimukham sa prabhu, a ram vinā blemish bāhya sya bi flock, ù thy estimation, šè a trespass offering, prati bi priest:
ca bi priest shall dim an atonement šè him before sa prabhu: u3 tat shall me forgiven him mu any thing ak viśva yad bi hath done a trespassing therein.
u3 sa lugal spake abhimukham moses, vac,

command aaron ù asya ātmaja, e, etat is bi law sya sa burnt offering: ne is bi burnt offering, because asya sa burning upari bi altar šu rājani prati bi uṣas, tathā bi fire ak bi altar shall me burning madhye tat.

u3 eṣa priest shall put on bi linen garment, tathā asya linen breeches shall eṣa put upari asya flesh, ca take up bi ashes lú bi fire hath consumed saha bi burnt offering on eṣa altar, tathā sa shall put etān beside sa altar.
u3 sa shall put off bi garments, api put on other garments, u3 carry forth bi ashes nu sa camp prati a clean šà.

ù bi fire šu-ba tad altar shall bhū burning antar ne; idam shall mā me put è: u3 bi priest shall burn wood on tat every prātas, ù lay bi burnt offering ša order par bi; ù sa shall burn thereon tad fat asya eṣa peace offerings.
bi fire shall ever me burning šu-ba bi altar; tat shall never gen è.
u3 idam is bi law ak tad meat offering: sa ibila ak aaron shall offer bi before bi prabhu, before bi altar.

ù ani shall take ak ne bi handful, ak sa flour ak bi meat offering, api ak sa oil thereof, ca gištug bi frankincense ša is ugu sa meat offering, ù shall burn ne upari eṣa altar mu a sweet savour, even tad memorial ak bi, šè sa lugal.
u3 bi remainder thereof shall aaron ù asya dumu eat: da unleavened bread shall ne as eaten ša tad holy deśa; a bi court ak bi tabernacle sya tad congregation they shall eat bi.
ne shall nu vṛt baken da leaven. i have given ne šè bi-ne mu bi-meš portion sya my offerings nirmā by fire; tat is most holy, as is sa sin offering, api as sa trespass offering.

niĝ sa males among bi children sya aaron shall eat ak bi. idam shall as a statute arthạm ever madhye your generations concerning eṣa offerings ak bi nātha dim by fire: every eka tad toucheth tān shall vṛt holy.
u3 bi nātha spake šè moses, vac,

idam is tad offering asya aaron u3 ak asya dumu, lú they shall offer šè tad svāmin madhye sa ud when ani is anointed; bi tenth part sya an ephah ak fine flour mu a meat offering perpetual, half ak ne a sa u4-zal, api half thereof at rājani.
ša a pan ne shall me dù ù oil; tathā when idam is baken, thou shalt bring ne madhye: api bi baken pieces ak tad meat offering shalt thou offer šè a sweet savour abhimukham eṣa svāmin.
ù bi priest sya bi ātmaja iri is anointed antar bi stead shall offer idam: idam is a statute šè ever šè tad ensi; bi shall as wholly burnt.
kṛte every meat offering mu bi priest shall as wholly burnt: tat shall mā vṛt eaten.
u3 tad nātha spake prati moses, dug4,
speak šè aaron ù šè ani ibila, inim, etat is bi law ak bi sin offering: ša sa šà where sa burnt offering is killed shall sa sin offering me killed before bi en: tat is most holy.
sa priest yad offereth tat kṛte sin shall eat tat: a bi holy šà shall tat as eaten, ša bi court ak tad tabernacle ak bi congregation.
whatsoever shall touch bi flesh thereof shall as holy: api when ne is sprinkled ak sa blood thereof upari any garment, thou shalt wash iri whereon idam bhū sprinkled ša bi holy deśa.
but bi earthen vessel wherein ne is sodden shall as broken: ca if tat as sodden antar a brasen pot, bi shall as both scoured, ca rinsed ša ídim.
viśva bi males among tad priests shall eat thereof: bi is most holy.
tathā na sin offering, whereof any ak eṣa blood is brought a sa tabernacle ak sa congregation prati reconcile withal madhye sa holy deśa, shall gál eaten: idam shall gál burnt ša sa fire.
likewise etat is bi law sya bi trespass offering: ne is most holy.
a bi šà where they kill sa burnt offering shall they kill tad trespass offering: ù sa blood thereof shall ani sprinkle round about upari eṣa altar.
ca ayam shall offer sya tat šu tad fat thereof; sa rump, api eṣa fat tad covereth sa inwards,
tathā bi dvau kidneys, ca tad fat tad is on bi-ne, yad is by bi flanks, u3 bi caul tad is ūrdhva tad liver, sahita bi kidneys, ne shall sa take away:
ù bi priest shall burn bi-ne ugu eṣa altar šè an offering dù by fire abhimukham eṣa lugal: ne is a trespass offering.
every male among bi priests shall eat thereof: bi shall as eaten madhye tad holy šà: ne is most holy.
as bi sin offering is, ittham is bi trespass offering: ne is diš law mu bi-ne: bi priest yad maketh atonement therewith shall have ne.
u3 bi priest iri offereth any man's burnt offering, even eṣa priest shall have prati himself sa skin asya eṣa burnt offering lú ayam hath offered.
ù sakala tad meat offering yad is baken madhye bi oven, ù niĝ tad is dressed a tad fryingpan, api a bi pan, shall me bi priest's ne offereth tat.
ù every meat offering, mingled ù oil, api nirjala, shall gištug sa putra sya aaron have, prathama as much as another.
u3 idam is eṣa law sya tad sacrifice asya peace offerings, lú bi shall offer šè bi svāmin.

if eṣa offer tat arthạm a thanksgiving, then ani shall offer sahita bi sacrifice sya thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled sahita oil, u3 unleavened wafers anointed da oil, api cakes mingled ù oil, sya fine flour, fried.
besides bi cakes, eṣa shall offer mu tasya offering leavened bread sahita tad sacrifice ak thanksgiving ak ani peace offerings.
ca ak ne sa shall offer diš bar sya bi whole oblation arthạm an heave offering abhimukham sa en, u3 idam shall gál bi priest's tad sprinkleth tad blood sya bi peace offerings.
api eṣa flesh ak bi sacrifice sya bi peace offerings kṛte thanksgiving shall vṛt eaten bi same u4 tad idam is offered; ayam shall ul leave any ak tat until sa u4-zal.

but if eṣa sacrifice sya bi offering me a vow, or a voluntary offering, tat shall me eaten eṣa same divasa yad ani offereth asya sacrifice: ca on tad morrow also eṣa remainder asya tat shall bhū eaten:
but tad remainder ak bi flesh ak eṣa sacrifice on tad 3-kam dina shall vṛt burnt da fire.

u3 if any ak tad flesh ak tad sacrifice sya ani peace offerings me eaten at viśva on bi tri ud, tat shall ul bhū accepted, neither shall ne gál imputed abhimukham him tad offereth ne: idam shall vṛt an abomination, tathā tad soul yad eateth ak ne shall bear tasya iniquity.
ca sa flesh tad toucheth any unclean thing shall na gál eaten; idam shall vṛt burnt da fire: tathā as mu sa flesh, sakala ne gál clean shall eat thereof.
but bi soul tad eateth ak bi flesh sya sa sacrifice ak peace offerings, iri pertain abhimukham bi svāmin, having asya uncleanness šu-ba him, even iri soul shall bhū cut off ta ani ukkin.

moreover bi soul yad shall touch any unclean thing, as bi uncleanness ak lú, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, u3 eat ak bi flesh asya bi sacrifice sya peace offerings, ša pertain šè bi en, even ne soul shall me cut off ta bi prajā.
api sa svāmin spake prati moses, inim,
speak prati bi children sya israel, brū, ye shall eat nahi manner ak fat, ak ox, or sya sheep, or asya goat.
tathā eṣa fat asya bi beast tad dieth sya itself, ca bi fat asya iri yaḥ is torn da beasts, may bhū used a any other use: but ye shall ša nu wise eat sya ne.
mu whosoever eateth eṣa fat ak bi beast, sya yad men offer an offering nirmā by fire prati bi lugal, even sa soul tad eateth idam shall as cut off prabhṛti ani ukkin.
moreover ye shall eat nahi manner sya blood, whether bi bhū ak fowl or asya beast, antar any ak your dwellings.
whatsoever soul bi me yad eateth any manner asya blood, even tad soul shall as cut off tas ani saĝ.
ù bi en spake šè moses, e,
speak šè bi children sya israel, brū, ayam tad offereth bi sacrifice sya ani peace offerings šè bi ensi shall bring ani oblation šè sa lugal sya sa sacrifice ak ani peace offerings.
asya own hands shall bring bi offerings asya bi lugal gag by fire, bi fat saha tad breast, tat shall sa bring, iri bi breast may me waved mu a wave offering before bi nātha.
ù eṣa priest shall burn eṣa fat par sa altar: but tad breast shall gál aaron's ù ani sons'.
ca eṣa right shoulder shall ye give šè sa priest šè an heave offering asya sa sacrifices asya your peace offerings.
ani among bi ibila asya aaron, tad offereth bi blood sya tad peace offerings, ù sa fat, shall have bi right shoulder šè bi part.

šè sa wave breast u3 bi heave shoulder have i taken asya bi children asya israel tas off sa sacrifices ak teṣām peace offerings, u3 have given etān šè aaron bi priest u3 abhimukham tasya suta by a statute arthạm ever prabhṛti among tad children ak israel.

ne is bi portion sya tad anointing asya aaron, api ak bi anointing ak bi suta, bāhya ak bi offerings sya bi lugal dù by fire, antar bi u4 when eṣa presented etān šè minister prati bi en madhye bi priest's office;
yaḥ bi en commanded šè bhū given bi-ne sya eṣa children asya israel, a bi divasa yad ayam anointed tān, by a statute arthạm ever throughout bi-meš generations.
bi is tad law asya eṣa burnt offering, ak eṣa meat offering, u3 ak eṣa sin offering, api sya bi trespass offering, ca asya sa consecrations, ca asya bi sacrifice asya bi peace offerings;
yad bi lugal commanded moses ša mount sinai, ša eṣa divasa iri eṣa commanded bi children asya israel prati offer bi-meš oblations abhimukham tad lugal, ša bi wilderness ak sinai.
ca sa nātha spake šè moses, vac,
take aaron ù bi dumu sahita him, api sa garments, api tad anointing oil, u3 a bullock mu eṣa sin offering, ca dvi rams, u3 a basket ak unleavened bread;
ca sañcay thou sakala tad congregation ús šè bi door ak bi tabernacle asya eṣa congregation.
ù moses did as sa lugal commanded him; tathā bi assembly me gar saha abhimukham bi door asya sa tabernacle ak bi congregation.
tathā moses vac šè bi congregation, idam is bi thing lú bi svāmin commanded abhimukham gál done.
u3 moses brought aaron u3 tasya dumu, u3 washed bi-ne sahita ídim.
u3 eṣa put ugu him sa coat, api girded him sahita bi girdle, ca clothed him da eṣa robe, u3 put tad ephod šu-ba him, ù bi girded him saha sa curious girdle ak bi ephod, ca bound ne šè him therewith.
ù eṣa put tad breastplate šu-ba him: also ani put a eṣa breastplate eṣa urim api bi thummim.
u3 ani put bi mitre šu-ba tasya head; also par tad mitre, even par bi forefront, did ani put bi golden plate, bi holy crown; as eṣa ensi commanded moses.
u3 moses took eṣa anointing oil, tathā anointed bi tabernacle u3 gištug iri gál therein, api sanctified etān.
ù sa sprinkled thereof upari tad altar seven times, u3 anointed sa altar ca šu tasya vessels, both eṣa laver ca ani foot, šè sanctify etān.
ù sa poured sya bi anointing oil ugu aaron's head, u3 anointed him, prati sanctify him.
ca moses brought aaron's suta, ù put coats ugu etān, ca girded etān saha girdles, u3 put bonnets upari etān; as tad lugal commanded moses.
ù sa brought tad bullock mu bi sin offering: u3 aaron api ani dumu laid bi-meš hands ugu eṣa head sya tad bullock kṛte bi sin offering.

ù ani slew ne; ù moses took sa blood, ca put bi ugu bi horns sya eṣa altar round about saha tasya finger, tathā purified bi altar, api poured tad blood at eṣa bottom ak bi altar, ca sanctified ne, šè gag reconciliation upari tat.
api ayam took viśva bi fat yad bhū šu-ba tad inwards, tathā bi caul ugu eṣa liver, ù eṣa min kidneys, u3 teṣām fat, api moses burned bi upari eṣa altar.
but sa bullock, api asya hide, tasya flesh, tathā bi dung, sa burnt saha fire rahita bi camp; as bi en commanded moses.
u3 ayam brought bi ram arthạm bi burnt offering: api aaron ù bi dumu laid teṣām hands par eṣa head ak tad ram.
ù ayam killed idam; api moses sprinkled bi blood ugu sa altar round about.
tathā eṣa cut tad ram a pieces; ca moses burnt bi head, ca sa pieces, u3 bi fat.

tathā bi washed eṣa inwards ù eṣa legs madhye udaka; ca moses burnt bi whole ram ugu sa altar: bi gál a burnt sacrifice kṛte a sweet savour, tathā an offering gag by fire abhimukham bi ensi; as bi prabhu commanded moses.
ù ani brought bi other ram, sa ram ak consecration: api aaron ù bi suta laid bi-meš hands šu-ba bi head sya bi ram.
u3 ani slew bi; tathā moses took sya eṣa blood ak bi, ù put bi upari bi tip ak aaron's right ear, ca upari bi thumb asya asya right hand, api šu-ba bi mahā toe ak asya right foot.

ù sa brought aaron's ibila, tathā moses put sya tad blood par eṣa tip sya bi-meš right ear, u3 par eṣa thumbs sya teṣām right hands, ù šu-ba tad mahā toes ak bi-meš right feet: tathā moses sprinkled tad blood upari sa altar round about.
ca bi took tad fat, tathā bi rump, ca sakala bi fat tad gál upari bi inwards, tathā tad caul ūrdhva bi liver, ca sa min kidneys, u3 bi-meš fat, tathā bi right shoulder:
u3 è sya bi basket ak unleavened bread, ne as before eṣa nātha, ayam took prathama unleavened cake, u3 a cake sya oiled bread, u3 aš wafer, ca put etān on sa fat, tathā par bi right shoulder:
api sa put šu šu-ba aaron's hands, u3 par ani sons' hands, api waved bi-ne kṛte a wave offering before tad svāmin.
ù moses took etān ta off bi-meš hands, ù burnt bi-ne on tad altar par sa burnt offering: they as consecrations mu a sweet savour: idam is an offering gag by fire prati bi lugal.
ù moses took sa breast, ù waved tat šè a wave offering before tad prabhu: šè sya bi ram asya consecration bi gál moses' part; as bi ensi commanded moses.

api moses took ak tad anointing oil, u3 asya bi blood yad as šu-ba sa altar, u3 sprinkled tat par aaron, ù par tasya garments, ca šu-ba tasya putra, ca ugu bi sons' garments saha him; ù sanctified aaron, u3 ani garments, u3 ani ibila, ù tasya sons' garments saha him.

api moses dug4 prati aaron ù prati bi putra, boil bi flesh at bi door ak bi tabernacle sya bi congregation: api tatra eat bi saha bi bread iri is a eṣa basket sya consecrations, as i commanded, kathay, aaron ù ani dumu shall eat idam.
u3 iri yad remaineth asya sa flesh u3 ak bi bread shall ye burn ù fire.
api ye shall nu gen è sya bi door ak eṣa tabernacle asya bi congregation ša seven days, until eṣa days sya your consecration me at an end: šè seven days shall bi consecrate you.
as eṣa hath done etat divasa, ittham bi en hath commanded šè do, šè dim an atonement šè you.
therefore shall ye abide at eṣa door sya eṣa tabernacle ak sa congregation u4 ù niśā seven days, u3 keep bi charge sya tad ensi, yad ye pralī ul: kṛte ga-nam i am commanded.
ga-nam aaron ù asya putra did sakala things yaḥ sa en commanded by eṣa hand ak moses.
api ne ā-gam šè pass on bi eighth divasa, tad moses mu-ù aaron tathā asya dumu, ca sa elders asya israel;
u3 ani e prati aaron, take thee a young calf mu a sin offering, ca a ram kṛte a burnt offering, nu blemish, ca offer bi-ne before tad en.
u3 šè bi children ak israel thou shalt speak, inim, take ye a kid ak eṣa goats mu a sin offering; ù a calf ca a lamb, both ak tad ādya year, ul blemish, arthạm a burnt offering;
also a bullock tathā a ram arthạm peace offerings, šè sacrifice before eṣa ensi; tathā a meat offering mingled da oil: šè abhimukham u4 bi ensi will è prati you.
u3 they brought ne yad moses commanded before bi tabernacle asya tad congregation: ca šu tad congregation drew near tathā stood before sa en.
tathā moses e, idam is bi thing ša sa ensi commanded tad ye should do: u3 sa glory ak sa prabhu shall suh šè you.

u3 moses vac šè aaron, yā šè bi altar, u3 offer thy sin offering, ù thy burnt offering, u3 dim an atonement šè thyself, u3 šè tad ùĝ: ca offer eṣa offering ak sa prajā, tathā dù an atonement arthạm bi-ne; as bi nātha commanded.
aaron therefore du šè bi altar, ù slew tad calf asya tad sin offering, ša me kṛte himself.
u3 tad dumu asya aaron brought bi blood abhimukham him: ù ayam dipped tasya finger ša bi blood, ca put ne šu-ba tad horns sya bi altar, ù poured è bi blood at sa bottom ak tad altar:
but sa fat, ù bi kidneys, api eṣa caul upari bi liver sya eṣa sin offering, bi burnt šu-ba bi altar; as bi lugal commanded moses.
api bi flesh tathā bi hide ani burnt saha fire vinā bi camp.
ca bi slew sa burnt offering; u3 aaron's ibila presented šè him tad blood, ša ayam sprinkled round about šu-ba bi altar.
ca they presented bi burnt offering abhimukham him, saha bi pieces thereof, ù tad head: ca sa burnt bi-ne šu-ba sa altar.
ù sa did wash bi inwards api bi legs, u3 burnt etān par bi burnt offering on eṣa altar.
api bi brought tad people's offering, ù took eṣa goat, yaḥ bhū sa sin offering kṛte sa ùĝ, ù slew tat, u3 offered tat arthạm sin, as bi prathama.
u3 sa brought tad burnt offering, tathā offered ne according abhimukham sa manner.
u3 bi brought sa meat offering, tathā took an handful thereof, u3 burnt tat upari sa altar, beside sa burnt sacrifice asya bi u4-ul-li.
sa slew also eṣa bullock ù sa ram arthạm a sacrifice ak peace offerings, ša me arthạm bi jana: api aaron's putra presented prati him tad blood, lú ani sprinkled upari bi altar round about,
api sa fat asya bi bullock ca sya sa ram, eṣa rump, api iri yaḥ covereth bi inwards, u3 bi kidneys, tathā sa caul ugu bi liver:
u3 they put bi fat par bi breasts, ca eṣa burnt bi fat upari bi altar:
u3 eṣa breasts u3 sa right shoulder aaron waved šè a wave offering before eṣa prabhu; as moses commanded.
u3 aaron lifted up ani hand toward eṣa jana, tathā blessed bi-ne, ù è down ta offering ak bi sin offering, tathā tad burnt offering, u3 peace offerings.
tathā moses ù aaron yā praviśya tad tabernacle ak sa congregation, u3 āyā bāhya, ca blessed sa prajā: tathā bi glory ak bi en appeared prati gištug eṣa prajā.
tathā tatra du a fire bāhya tas before bi nātha, api consumed par bi altar bi burnt offering u3 eṣa fat: yad when sarva eṣa loka paś, they shouted, tathā fell on bi-meš faces.
ù nadab tathā abihu, sa ibila sya aaron, took either sya bi-ne bi censer, api put fire therein, ca put incense thereon, u3 offered strange fire before eṣa prabhu, lú sa commanded bi-ne na.
u3 ni vraj bahis fire tas bi en, api devoured bi-ne, ù they died before eṣa prabhu.
then moses kathay abhimukham aaron, ne is idam yad bi prabhu spake, vac, i will gál sanctified antar bi-ne iri è nigh me, ù before sarva tad saĝ i will bhū glorified. tathā aaron held ani peace.
ca moses mu-ù mishael api elzaphan, tad ibila ak uzziel sa uncle asya aaron, u3 dug4 šè tān, ā-gam near, carry your brethren tas before sa sanctuary bar ak bi camp.
ga-nam they gen near, api carried etān madhye eṣām coats è ak bi camp; as moses had inim.

ù moses inim šè aaron, ù abhimukham eleazar api abhimukham ithamar, ani dumu, uncover nu your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye kāl, api lest wrath āyā šu-ba sarva bi ukkin: but gá your brethren, tad whole geh sya israel, bewail tad burning yaḥ tad nātha hath kindled.
u3 ye shall na yā bāhya prabhṛti sa door ak sa tabernacle sya sa congregation, lest ye úš: mu tad anointing oil ak eṣa prabhu is ugu you. tathā they did according abhimukham sa word ak moses.
ù bi svāmin spake šè aaron, vac,
do mā drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy dumu sahita thee, when ye è praviśya eṣa tabernacle ak bi congregation, lest ye úš: bi shall me a statute kṛte ever throughout your generations:
ù ne ye may put difference between holy u3 unholy, u3 between unclean tathā clean;
ù ne ye may teach tad children ak israel gištug bi statutes ša bi lugal hath spoken abhimukham bi-ne by tad hand asya moses.

api moses spake prati aaron, api šè eleazar api abhimukham ithamar, bi ibila tad as left, take sa meat offering iri remaineth sya tad offerings sya bi nātha nirmā by fire, ca eat ne nu leaven beside bi altar: arthạm tat is most holy:
ù ye shall eat ne antar bi holy deśa, because tat is thy due, ù thy sons' due, ak tad sacrifices sya bi nātha nirmā by fire: kṛte ga-nam i am commanded.

ù bi wave breast tathā heave shoulder shall ye eat madhye a clean ki; thou, ù thy dumu, u3 thy daughters saha thee: arthạm they gál thy due, u3 thy sons' due, ša are given bar ak bi sacrifices ak peace offerings sya bi children asya israel.

bi heave shoulder u3 eṣa wave breast shall they bring ù tad offerings dim by fire ak sa fat, abhimukham wave bi šè a wave offering before eṣa en; u3 bi shall as thine, api thy sons' sahita thee, by a statute mu ever; as bi lugal hath commanded.
tathā moses diligently sought sa goat sya eṣa sin offering, ù, behold, tat vṛt burnt: ù eṣa me angry da eleazar ù ithamar, bi ibila ak aaron lú me left alive, brū,

wherefore have ye ul eaten bi sin offering madhye bi holy deśa, seeing idam is most holy, u3 deva hath given tat you abhimukham bear tad iniquity sya sa congregation, prati dim atonement kṛte bi-ne before eṣa prabhu?
behold, bi blood sya bi bhū ul brought ša within bi holy ki: ye should indeed have eaten bi ša bi holy ki, as i commanded.

ca aaron kathay prati moses, behold, etat ud have they offered eṣām sin offering u3 bi-meš burnt offering before tad nātha; ù such things have befallen me: api if i had eaten sa sin offering prati u4, should tat have bhū accepted madhye bi sight ak bi svāmin?
u3 when moses heard iri, ani me content.
ca bi nātha spake šè moses tathā prati aaron, brū abhimukham etān,
speak abhimukham tad children sya israel, brū, these are tad beasts yad ye shall eat among niĝ bi beasts ne are on bi bhūmi.
whatsoever parteth sa hoof, api is clovenfooted, ù cheweth bi cud, among bi beasts, tad shall ye eat.
nevertheless these shall ye ul eat sya bi-ne tad chew sa cud, or sya tān tad sag-ki tad hoof: as bi camel, because eṣa cheweth sa cud, but divideth ul bi hoof; eṣa is unclean šè you.
ù bi coney, because bi cheweth bi cud, but divideth na bi hoof; sa is unclean abhimukham you.
ù eṣa hare, because bi cheweth bi cud, but divideth na bi hoof; bi is unclean šè you.
api bi swine, though bi ba sa hoof, tathā vṛt clovenfooted, yet sa cheweth mā tad cud; eṣa is unclean šè you.
ak bi-meš flesh shall ye na eat, ù teṣām carcase shall ye ul touch; they are unclean prati you.
these shall ye eat asya gištug tad are ša bi jala: whatsoever hath fins u3 scales antar bi ap, a bi seas, ù a tad rivers, etān shall ye eat.
tathā niĝ iri have mā fins ca scales a bi seas, u3 ša tad rivers, ak sarva tad cal madhye bi ídim, u3 asya any living thing lú is madhye bi ap, they shall gál an abomination šè you:
they shall bhū even an abomination šè you; ye shall mā eat asya teṣām flesh, but ye shall have bi-meš carcases a abomination.
whatsoever hath nu fins nor scales antar tad jala, iri shall as an abomination šè you.
api these are they lú ye shall have ša abomination among sa fowls; they shall ul gál eaten, they are an abomination: bi eagle, u3 bi ossifrage, api bi ospray,
ù eṣa vulture, tathā bi kite after tasya kind;
every raven after ani kind;
api eṣa owl, ù bi gi6 hawk, tathā bi cuckow, ù bi hawk after ani kind,
tathā tad little owl, ca bi cormorant, ù bi gal owl,
ca bi swan, ù bi pelican, u3 tad gier eagle,
ù bi stork, eṣa heron after tasyāḥ kind, ca bi lapwing, api bi bat.
sarva fowls tad creep, going šu-ba šu four, shall as an abomination abhimukham you.
yet these may ye eat ak every flying creeping thing iri goeth ugu viśva four, yad have legs ugu bi-meš feet, šè leap withal ugu eṣa dharā;
even these asya etān ye may eat; bi locust after asya kind, u3 tad bald locust after asya kind, u3 bi beetle after asya kind, tathā sa grasshopper after ani kind.
but sarva other flying creeping things, lú have four feet, shall me an abomination abhimukham you.
api arthạm these ye shall gál unclean: whosoever toucheth tad carcase asya bi-ne shall me unclean until tad even.
tathā whosoever beareth ought ak sa carcase asya bi-ne shall wash asya clothes, tathā gál unclean until bi even.
sa carcases asya every beast lú divideth bi hoof, api is ul clovenfooted, nor cheweth sa cud, are unclean šè you: every prathama iri toucheth tān shall as unclean.
ù whatsoever goeth par ani paws, among sakala manner sya beasts iri du on niĝ four, those are unclean abhimukham you: whoso toucheth bi-meš carcase shall gál unclean until bi even.
ca sa yad beareth eṣa carcase ak etān shall wash ani clothes, api vṛt unclean until tad even: they are unclean šè you.
these also shall bhū unclean abhimukham you among bi creeping things ne creep ugu sa kalam; eṣa weasel, u3 bi mouse, ca tad tortoise after asya kind,
tathā eṣa ferret, u3 tad chameleon, tathā eṣa lizard, u3 bi snail, ca sa mole.
these are unclean šè you among šu yad creep: whosoever doth touch etān, when they gál dead, shall gál unclean until sa even.

tathā ugu whatsoever any ak tān, when they are dead, doth fall, ne shall bhū unclean; whether ne gál any vessel ak wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel ne me, wherein any work is done, bi must bhū put šè ídim, u3 tat shall bhū unclean until eṣa even; ga-nam idam shall as cleansed.
ù every earthen vessel, whereinto any asya tān falleth, whatsoever is a tat shall me unclean; api ye shall break tat.
ak viśva meat yad may gál eaten, ne on yaḥ such ap cometh shall vṛt unclean: ù šu drink yad may gál drunk antar every such vessel shall gál unclean.
api every thing whereupon any part ak bi-meš carcase falleth shall gál unclean; whether bi me oven, or ranges mu pots, they shall me broken down: mu they are unclean, tathā shall as unclean šè you.
nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein atra is plenty ak udaka, shall as clean: but iri ša toucheth bi-meš carcase shall vṛt unclean.
ù if any part sya bi-meš carcase fall upari any sowing seed yad is šè as sown, bi shall bhū clean.
but if any udaka bhū put upari tad seed, api any part asya bi-meš carcase fall thereon, tat shall gál unclean prati you.
ù if any beast, sya yad ye may eat, kāl; sa iri toucheth bi carcase thereof shall gál unclean until bi even.
ù ani tad eateth asya eṣa carcase asya idam shall wash tasya clothes, u3 bhū unclean until eṣa even: eṣa also tad beareth bi carcase ak bi shall wash tasya clothes, tathā vṛt unclean until sa even.
api every creeping thing iri creepeth šu-ba bi ki shall me an abomination; tat shall mā vṛt eaten.

whatsoever goeth par eṣa belly, ca whatsoever goeth ugu sakala four, or whatsoever hath more feet among sarva creeping things ne creep šu-ba tad pṛthivī, tān ye shall nu eat; arthạm they are an abomination.
ye shall mā dù yourselves abominable saha any creeping thing iri creepeth, neither shall ye dim yourselves unclean saha bi-ne, tad ye should gál defiled thereby.

mu i am tad lugal your bhagavān: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, ù ye shall me holy; arthạm i am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves saha any manner ak creeping thing tad creepeth par bi kalam.
mu i am tad svāmin yad bringeth you up bahis sya bi bhū sya egypt, abhimukham gál your ilum: ye shall therefore gál holy, arthạm i am holy.
bi is tad law sya tad beasts, u3 ak bi fowl, ca asya every living creature yad moveth ša sa ap, ù ak every creature ne creepeth šu-ba eṣa kalam:
abhimukham vidh a difference between sa unclean api bi clean, ù between sa beast yad may gál eaten u3 bi beast tad may na gál eaten.
ca bi prabhu spake šè moses, inim,

speak šè tad children asya israel, dug4, if a strī have conceived seed, ù born a manuṣya child: then she shall me unclean seven days; according prati tad days asya bi separation šè ani-munus infirmity shall she gál unclean.
tathā madhye bi eighth u4 sa flesh ak asya foreskin shall vṛt circumcised.

ca she shall then continue a tad blood ak ani-munus purifying three tathā thirty days; she shall touch nu hallowed thing, nor du antar bi sanctuary, until eṣa days ak ani-munus purifying me fulfilled.
but if she bear a maid child, then she shall gál unclean min weeks, as a asyāḥ separation: api she shall continue a eṣa blood asya ani-munus purifying threescore ca six days.

u3 when bi days ak asyāḥ purifying are fulfilled, kṛte a ibila, or šè a daughter, she shall bring a lamb asya bi imin year šè a burnt offering, ù a young pigeon, or a turtledove, arthạm a sin offering, prati tad door asya bi tabernacle sya tad congregation, šè bi priest:
who shall offer ne before bi ensi, tathā dim an atonement arthạm ani-munus; tathā she shall gál cleansed ta eṣa issue sya asyāḥ blood. bi is tad law mu ani-munus yad hath born a male or a female.

api if she me na able šè bring a lamb, then she shall bring dvau turtles, or min young pigeons; eṣa eka mu bi burnt offering, ca bi other šè a sin offering: tathā bi priest shall gag an atonement mu tasyāḥ, u3 she shall vṛt clean.
tathā sa lugal spake šè moses u3 aaron, dug4,

when a puruṣa shall have antar bi skin ak ani flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, ca ne vṛt a eṣa skin ak asya flesh like bi plague sya leprosy; then ayam shall gál brought prati aaron bi priest, or šè diš ak asya dumu sa priests:

ca bi priest shall look on bi plague madhye bi skin ak bi flesh: ca when bi hair a bi plague is turned white, tathā bi plague madhye sight as deeper than bi skin asya tasya flesh, idam is a plague sya leprosy: u3 bi priest shall look on him, tathā pronounce him unclean.

if bi bright spot gál white madhye bi skin ak tasya flesh, api madhye sight gál nu deeper than tad skin, tathā bi hair thereof me mā turned white; then tad priest shall shut up him tad hath tad plague seven days:
u3 bi priest shall look on him bi seventh divasa: u3, behold, if tad plague madhye bi sight bhū at a stay, u3 bi plague spread mā a bi skin; then bi priest shall shut him up seven days more:

ca sa priest shall look on him again bi seventh u4: ù, behold, if bi plague bhū somewhat gi6, tathā bi plague spread mā antar eṣa skin, bi priest shall pronounce him clean: idam is but a scab: u3 sa shall wash bi clothes, tathā bhū clean.
but if sa scab spread much abroad ša bi skin, after ne bi hath vṛt paś sya bi priest šè tasya cleansing, ani shall gál paś sya sa priest again:
api if tad priest igi iri, behold, tad scab spreadeth antar sa skin, then sa priest shall pronounce him unclean: ne is a leprosy.
when bi plague ak leprosy is antar a guruš, then bi shall me brought šè bi priest;
u3 eṣa priest shall lok him: ù, behold, if bi rising gál white madhye tad skin, api tat have turned bi hair white, tathā tatra as quick raw flesh madhye bi rising;
idam is an old leprosy ša bi skin asya ani flesh, u3 bi priest shall pronounce him unclean, ca shall mā shut him up: arthạm sa is unclean.
ca if a leprosy break bāhya abroad madhye bi skin, u3 bi leprosy cover šu sa skin ak him ne hath sa plague ta asya head even abhimukham bi foot, wheresoever bi priest looketh;
then bi priest shall consider: ù, behold, if tad leprosy have covered gištug ani flesh, sa shall pronounce him clean ne hath tad plague: bi is sakala turned white: ayam is clean.
but when raw flesh appeareth a him, ani shall gál unclean.
tathā bi priest shall lok bi raw flesh, ca pronounce him abhimukham gál unclean: arthạm bi raw flesh is unclean: ne is a leprosy.
or if bi raw flesh turn again, ù bhū changed šè white, ayam shall āyā prati eṣa priest;
u3 tad priest shall lok him: ù, behold, if tad plague gál turned šè white; then bi priest shall pronounce him clean tad hath tad plague: sa is clean.
bi flesh also, a yaḥ, even a bi skin thereof, me a boil, tathā is healed,
ù ša eṣa ki ak bi boil tatra bhū a white rising, or a bright spot, white, u3 somewhat reddish, tathā tat as shewed šè tad priest;

u3 if, when bi priest seeth idam, behold, ne gál antar sight lower than eṣa skin, ca tad hair thereof me turned white; tad priest shall pronounce him unclean: ne is a plague ak leprosy broken bāhya ak tad boil.
but if bi priest look on tat, u3, behold, tatra vṛt nahi white hairs therein, tathā if ne as nu lower than eṣa skin, but as somewhat timira; then eṣa priest shall shut him up seven days:
api if idam spread much abroad ša eṣa skin, then bi priest shall pronounce him unclean: ne is a plague.
but if bi bright spot stay ša bi sthāna, u3 spread na, bi is a burning boil; u3 bi priest shall pronounce him clean.
or if ni me any flesh, madhye tad skin whereof ne is a hot burning, ù bi quick flesh iri burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

then tad priest shall look upari bi: ù, behold, if bi hair antar sa bright spot me turned white, api idam vṛt ša sight deeper than bi skin; bi is a leprosy broken è sya bi burning: wherefore sa priest shall pronounce him unclean: idam is tad plague sya leprosy.
but if bi priest look on ne, ù, behold, ne vṛt nu white hair a tad bright spot, u3 ne bhū nu lower than sa other skin, but me somewhat timira; then tad priest shall shut him up seven days:
tathā bi priest shall look šu-ba him bi seventh ahar: u3 if tat gál spread much abroad madhye sa skin, then bi priest shall pronounce him unclean: bi is bi plague ak leprosy.

api if bi bright spot stay ša asya šà, api spread mā a bi skin, but idam me somewhat timira; tat is a rising ak bi burning, tathā bi priest shall pronounce him clean: arthạm ne is an inflammation ak tad burning.
if a nara or strī have a plague ugu tad head or sa beard;

then eṣa priest shall bar bi plague: tathā, behold, if bi gál antar sight deeper than tad skin; ù tatra gál ša idam a yellow thin hair; then bi priest shall pronounce him unclean: tat is a nirjala scall, even a leprosy upari bi head or beard.

api if bi priest look on eṣa plague ak tad scall, api, behold, bi gál ul a sight deeper than sa skin, u3 yad ne is nahi black hair madhye bi; then bi priest shall shut up him tad hath eṣa plague ak bi scall seven days:
tathā ša tad seventh ud bi priest shall look on tad plague: ù, behold, if eṣa scall spread ul, api ni gál antar bi nu yellow hair, ù eṣa scall me ul madhye sight deeper than bi skin;
ayam shall me shaven, but eṣa scall shall sa na shave; u3 bi priest shall shut up him iri hath eṣa scall seven days more:

ù antar tad seventh ahar eṣa priest shall look on bi scall: u3, behold, if bi scall as nu spread ša tad skin, nor vṛt antar sight deeper than bi skin; then tad priest shall pronounce him clean: ù bi shall wash ani clothes, ù vṛt clean.
but if bi scall spread much madhye bi skin after ani cleansing;
then eṣa priest shall look on him: ù, behold, if bi scall as spread a sa skin, eṣa priest shall mā seek arthạm yellow hair; eṣa is unclean.
but if bi scall bhū antar tasya sight at a stay, u3 yad ne is black hair grown up therein; tad scall is healed, ani is clean: tathā tad priest shall pronounce him clean.
if a nara also or a strī have a tad skin sya eṣām flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
then bi priest shall look: api, behold, if bi bright spots ša sa skin asya bi-meš flesh as darkish white; idam is a freckled spot ne groweth a sa skin; ani is clean.
ca bi puruṣa whose hair is fallen off asya head, ani is bald; yet is sa clean.
ù ani ne hath tasya hair fallen off tas bi part ak tasya head toward tasya pa, bi is forehead bald: yet is ani clean.
ca if tatra gál ša tad bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; idam is a leprosy sprung up antar ani bald head, or asya bald forehead.
then tad priest shall look upari tat: ù, behold, if bi rising ak bi sore bhū white reddish madhye asya bald head, or a bi bald forehead, as bi leprosy appeareth madhye tad skin sya bi flesh;
sa is a leprous lú, ani is unclean: eṣa priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; bi plague is madhye ani head.
ca tad leper a whom tad plague is, asya clothes shall me rent, ù asya head bare, api bi shall put a covering šu-ba tasya upper lip, api shall cry, unclean, unclean.
šu bi days wherein tad plague shall gál a him eṣa shall gál defiled; ayam is unclean: bi shall dwell alone; rahita sa camp shall bi habitation as.
eṣa garment also iri bi plague asya leprosy is ša, whether ne gál a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
whether ne as ša bi warp, or woof; ak linen, or asya woollen; whether madhye a skin, or a any thing kṛ ak skin;

ca if eṣa plague gál greenish or reddish antar bi garment, or madhye eṣa skin, either ša tad warp, or ša bi woof, or ša any thing ak skin; ne is a plague ak leprosy, u3 shall gál shewed šè eṣa priest:
ù bi priest shall look par sa plague, tathā shut up tat yad hath tad plague seven days:

ca sa shall look on eṣa plague on eṣa seventh ahar: if bi plague vṛt spread madhye bi garment, either a sa warp, or madhye tad woof, or ša a skin, or ša any work tad is vidh ak skin; bi plague is a fretting leprosy; idam is unclean.

sa shall therefore burn yad garment, whether warp or woof, madhye woollen or madhye linen, or any thing asya skin, wherein bi plague is: kṛte idam is a fretting leprosy; idam shall bhū burnt a bi fire.
tathā if bi priest shall look, ù, behold, bi plague bhū ul spread a tad garment, either a sa warp, or ša tad woof, or antar any thing asya skin;
then bi priest shall command tad they wash tad thing wherein sa plague is, ù sa shall shut bi up seven days more:

ca sa priest shall look on eṣa plague, after yad idam is washed: tathā, behold, if bi plague have ul changed tasya colour, ca bi plague as mā spread; ne is unclean; thou shalt burn idam ša bi fire; idam is fret inward, whether tat me bare within or nu.
ca if bi priest look, tathā, behold, bi plague as somewhat kuku after tad washing ak tat; then ani shall rend idam bahis ak tad garment, or bahis ak eṣa skin, or bar sya bi warp, or è ak bi woof:
u3 if tat suh still a eṣa garment, either madhye sa warp, or madhye tad woof, or a any thing ak skin; bi is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn tad wherein tad plague is saha fire.
api tad garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing ak skin tat gál, lú thou shalt wash, if bi plague me departed ta bi-ne, then ne shall vṛt washed bi min time, u3 shall me clean.
idam is bi law ak eṣa plague sya leprosy antar a garment sya woollen or linen, either ša bi warp, or woof, or any thing ak skins, abhimukham pronounce ne clean, or prati pronounce ne unclean.
api bi ensi spake šè moses, vac,
bi shall me bi law ak bi leper a tad ud ak asya cleansing: sa shall bhū brought abhimukham bi priest:
u3 bi priest shall gen forth bāhya ak tad camp; ù bi priest shall look, tathā, behold, if bi plague asya leprosy vṛt healed a bi leper;
then shall sa priest command šè take kṛte him iri is abhimukham me cleansed min birds alive ca clean, u3 cedar wood, ù scarlet, tathā hyssop:
api bi priest shall command iri eka sya sa birds bhū killed madhye an earthen vessel over running udaka:
as šè bi living bird, ani shall take tat, ù bi cedar wood, tathā sa scarlet, api bi hyssop, ca shall dip bi-ne ca bi living bird ša bi blood sya sa bird yad as killed over sa running ídim:
tathā ayam shall sprinkle šu-ba him yad is šè vṛt cleansed ta eṣa leprosy seven times, api shall pronounce him clean, ca shall dā tad living bird loose a tad open field.

ù ayam ne is prati gál cleansed shall wash bi clothes, u3 shave off gištug ani hair, u3 wash himself madhye a, tad ayam may gál clean: ca after yad sa shall ā-gam antar bi camp, ca shall tarry abroad bahis ak asya tent seven days.

but ne shall bhū on bi seventh ahar, ne ani shall shave sarva bi hair off asya head tathā ani beard tathā bi eyebrows, even sarva bi hair eṣa shall shave off: ca ayam shall wash ani clothes, also ani shall wash tasya flesh antar ídim, tathā eṣa shall gál clean.

api on bi eighth u4 sa shall take dvi bi lambs ul blemish, u3 aš ewe lamb asya bi prathama year ul blemish, ca three tenth deals asya fine flour arthạm a meat offering, mingled saha oil, tathā aš log sya oil.
u3 bi priest yad maketh him clean shall present eṣa guruš ne is prati as dù clean, tathā those things, before bi nātha, at bi door asya sa tabernacle ak bi congregation:
u3 sa priest shall take diš ayam lamb, api offer him arthạm a trespass offering, ù bi log ak oil, ca wave bi-ne mu a wave offering before eṣa lugal:

u3 eṣa shall slay bi lamb ša sa sthāna where sa shall kill bi sin offering u3 sa burnt offering, antar sa holy ki: arthạm as bi sin offering is sa priest's, evam is bi trespass offering: bi is most holy:

u3 bi priest shall take some sya sa blood sya bi trespass offering, ca bi priest shall put tat šu-ba eṣa tip asya bi right ear ak him yad is šè bhū cleansed, u3 šu-ba eṣa thumb ak bi right hand, ù upari tad gal toe ak asya right foot:
u3 bi priest shall take some asya bi log ak oil, ca pour bi a tad palm ak bi own left hand:
api bi priest shall dip tasya right finger madhye bi oil iri is a bi left hand, u3 shall sprinkle ak bi oil ù ani finger seven times before eṣa en:

ca ak bi rest ak bi oil tad is antar ani hand shall sa priest put par bi tip asya eṣa right ear asya him tad is šè gál cleansed, ù par bi thumb asya tasya right hand, u3 upari bi mahā toe ak tasya right foot, ugu sa blood asya eṣa trespass offering:
tathā bi remnant ak tad oil ne is madhye bi priest's hand bi shall pour šu-ba eṣa head ak him yad is prati gál cleansed: ù bi priest shall nirmā an atonement šè him before bi nātha.
ù bi priest shall offer tad sin offering, ù dù an atonement arthạm him ne is šè bhū cleansed ta tasya uncleanness; ù afterward sa shall kill bi burnt offering:
ù bi priest shall offer sa burnt offering u3 tad meat offering ugu eṣa altar: ù bi priest shall nirmā an atonement mu him, ca ani shall as clean.

tathā if sa as poor, u3 cannot get nu-me much; then eṣa shall take prathama lamb kṛte a trespass offering prati gál waved, abhimukham gag an atonement mu him, ca aš tenth deal ak fine flour mingled da oil šè a meat offering, ca a log ak oil;
u3 min turtledoves, or dvi young pigeons, such as ani is able šè get; u3 bi eka shall vṛt a sin offering, u3 bi other a burnt offering.
ù ayam shall bring bi-ne on eṣa eighth dina mu ani cleansing šè eṣa priest, abhimukham eṣa door sya tad tabernacle ak bi congregation, before bi svāmin.
ù bi priest shall take bi lamb ak bi trespass offering, u3 bi log ak oil, ù eṣa priest shall wave bi-ne mu a wave offering before bi ensi:

tathā ayam shall kill tad lamb ak bi trespass offering, tathā tad priest shall take some ak tad blood asya bi trespass offering, u3 put idam par eṣa tip ak bi right ear sya him yad is abhimukham gál cleansed, ca par bi thumb ak ani right hand, api par sa viśāla toe asya bi right foot:
ù bi priest shall pour ak tad oil a tad palm ak bi own left hand:
api tad priest shall sprinkle da tasya right finger some ak bi oil ne is a bi left hand seven times before tad en:

ca bi priest shall put sya bi oil tad is a asya hand par bi tip ak sa right ear sya him ne is šè bhū cleansed, ca šu-ba bi thumb sya bi right hand, ù ugu tad gu-la toe ak asya right foot, upari bi deśa sya sa blood ak bi trespass offering:
ù tad rest ak bi oil ne is a sa priest's hand sa shall put šu-ba bi head asya him tad is šè bhū cleansed, šè dù an atonement šè him before bi svāmin.
api sa shall offer bi diš ak eṣa turtledoves, or ak bi young pigeons, such as ayam can get;

even such as bi is able prati get, sa aš šè a sin offering, tathā bi other mu a burnt offering, sahita sa meat offering: u3 sa priest shall vidh an atonement kṛte him iri is šè as cleansed before bi prabhu.
ne is sa law ak him ša whom is bi plague ak leprosy, whose hand is mā able abhimukham get ne ša pertaineth šè tasya cleansing.
tathā bi lugal spake šè moses ca prati aaron, e,
when ye as āyā antar bi deśa ak canaan, ša i give šè you arthạm a possession, ù i put eṣa plague ak leprosy madhye a é ak tad kur ak your possession;
ù ani tad owneth sa ki-gal shall prāp ù tell bi priest, vac, tat seemeth abhimukham me ni is as idam bhū a plague antar eṣa geh:
then bi priest shall command tad they empty bi é, before tad priest du praviśya ne šè igi bi plague, yad šu yad is a tad ki-gal me mā kṛ unclean: ù afterward eṣa priest shall vraj a šè dṛś bi ki-gal:
api ani shall look on sa plague, ù, behold, if bi plague me ša bi walls ak eṣa gṛha ù hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, yad madhye sight are lower than eṣa wall;
then eṣa priest shall gen è asya sa é šè sa door sya bi geh, ù shut up bi gṛha seven days:
ù sa priest shall āyā again bi seventh u4, ù shall look: u3, behold, if bi plague me spread madhye sa walls ak bi geh;
then bi priest shall command yad they take away bi stones a yad eṣa plague is, u3 they shall cast bi-ne praviśya an unclean šà ul bi city:
ù bi shall cause tad é šè as scraped within round about, tathā they shall pour bar bi dust iri they scrape off rahita eṣa city praviśya an unclean šà:
tathā they shall take other stones, api put etān a sa ki ak those stones; api ani shall take other morter, ù shall plaister eṣa geh.
ca if sa plague du again, ù break bāhya a bi geh, after tad ani hath taken away bi stones, tathā after eṣa hath scraped bi sadana, tathā after tat is plaistered;
then eṣa priest shall è ca look, u3, behold, if bi plague gál spread a eṣa é, tat is a fretting leprosy antar bi ki-gal: bi is unclean.
api eṣa shall break down tad sadana, bi stones asya idam, tathā bi timber thereof, tathā sarva bi morter asya sa ki-gal; ca eṣa shall carry bi-ne forth è sya bi city šè an unclean ki.
moreover eṣa tad goeth šè bi gṛha gištug tad while yad tat is shut up shall bhū unclean until tad even.
u3 ayam tad lieth madhye eṣa sadana shall wash tasya clothes; u3 bi iri eateth antar tad geh shall wash tasya clothes.

tathā if bi priest shall du antar, u3 look šu-ba idam, u3, behold, tad plague hath nu spread antar bi é, after bi ki-gal as plaistered: then sa priest shall pronounce bi é clean, because tad plague is healed.
ù bi shall take šè cleanse sa ki-gal min birds, u3 cedar wood, u3 scarlet, ca hyssop:
ca ani shall kill bi aš sya bi birds antar an earthen vessel over running a:
ca ani shall take eṣa cedar wood, api bi hyssop, u3 tad scarlet, u3 bi living bird, ù dip tān antar bi blood ak bi slain bird, api antar bi running ap, ù sprinkle bi é seven times:
ù eṣa shall cleanse bi sadana sahita bi blood asya sa bird, u3 ù tad running ídim, ù sahita eṣa living bird, u3 sahita bi cedar wood, u3 saha bi hyssop, u3 sahita bi scarlet:
but ani shall he-me vraj sa living bird bar sya sa city šè eṣa open fields, u3 vidh an atonement arthạm tad ki-gal: ù tat shall me clean.
etat is bi law arthạm sarva manner sya plague asya leprosy, ù scall,
tathā arthạm tad leprosy sya a garment, ca asya a ki-gal,
ù mu a rising, u3 arthạm a scab, ù šè a bright spot:
abhimukham teach when ne is unclean, ca when idam is clean: etat is bi law ak leprosy.
tathā bi prabhu spake šè moses tathā prati aaron, brū,
speak šè bi children sya israel, ù dug4 prati etān, when any guruš hath a running issue bar ak ani flesh, because asya bi issue ani is unclean.
tathā bi shall as tasya uncleanness madhye tasya issue: whether ani flesh run da tasya issue, or tasya flesh gál stopped ta tasya issue, tat is ani uncleanness.
every bed, whereon bi lieth iri hath tad issue, is unclean: u3 every thing, whereon bi sitteth, shall bhū unclean.
ù whosoever toucheth bi bed shall wash tasya clothes, tathā bathe himself ša ídim, u3 gál unclean until tad even.
api ayam ne sitteth on any thing whereon bi sat yad hath sa issue shall wash tasya clothes, ca bathe himself antar ídim, api gál unclean until bi even.
api bi tad toucheth bi flesh ak him iri hath bi issue shall wash ani clothes, ca bathe himself a ap, u3 gál unclean until tad even.
api if ani tad hath sa issue spit šu-ba him tad is clean; then sa shall wash bi clothes, tathā bathe himself antar jala, ca bhū unclean until eṣa even.
u3 what saddle soever ani rideth ugu iri hath bi issue shall bhū unclean.

u3 whosoever toucheth any thing yad gál ki-ta him shall bhū unclean until bi even: tathā ani tad beareth any asya those things shall wash bi clothes, api bathe himself antar a, ca gál unclean until bi even.
api whomsoever bi toucheth ne hath bi issue, u3 hath ul rinsed tasya hands antar a, ani shall wash tasya clothes, api bathe himself a udaka, ù bhū unclean until bi even.
u3 sa vessel asya ki, yad ani toucheth yad hath bi issue, shall me broken: ù every vessel ak wood shall gál rinsed ša udaka.

api when eṣa iri hath an issue is cleansed sya bi issue; then bi shall number šè himself seven days šè asya cleansing, u3 wash asya clothes, tathā bathe tasya flesh madhye running ap, ù shall vṛt clean.
tathā on sa eighth u4 eṣa shall take šè him min turtledoves, or dvi young pigeons, ù prāp before bi svāmin šè tad door asya bi tabernacle sya tad congregation, api give bi-ne abhimukham tad priest:
ù tad priest shall offer bi-ne, eṣa diš šè a sin offering, ca tad other mu a burnt offering; u3 eṣa priest shall dù an atonement šè him before tad en mu tasya issue.
u3 if any man's seed ak copulation vraj bahis ta him, then eṣa shall wash sakala tasya flesh antar ídim, tathā gál unclean until eṣa even.
ù every garment, ù every skin, whereon is sa seed ak copulation, shall gál washed da jala, api me unclean until sa even.
sa sal also saha whom puruṣa shall lie sahita seed ak copulation, they shall both bathe themselves madhye ídim, ù bhū unclean until tad even.
tathā if a yoṣit have an issue, ù tasyāḥ issue a tasyāḥ flesh me blood, she shall gál put apart seven days: tathā whosoever toucheth tasyāḥ shall bhū unclean until sa even.
ca every thing iri she lieth šu-ba ša tasyāḥ separation shall as unclean: every thing also ne she sitteth par shall as unclean.
api whosoever toucheth ani-munus bed shall wash ani clothes, u3 bathe himself a ídim, ca as unclean until bi even.
ù whosoever toucheth any thing ne she sat par shall wash ani clothes, tathā bathe himself a ap, u3 vṛt unclean until bi even.
u3 if idam bhū on ani-munus bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when eṣa toucheth ne, eṣa shall vṛt unclean until bi even.
ca if any nara lie saha ani-munus at niĝ, u3 ani-munus flowers bhū par him, ayam shall vṛt unclean seven days; ca šu bi bed whereon bi lieth shall vṛt unclean.

ù if a munus have an issue ak ani-munus blood many days è ak sa time sya ani-munus separation, or if ne run beyond bi time sya ani-munus separation; sarva bi days ak tad issue asya ani-munus uncleanness shall bhū as eṣa days ak tasyāḥ separation: she shall as unclean.

every bed whereon she lieth niĝ bi days ak ani-munus issue shall as prati ani-munus as eṣa bed ak asyāḥ separation: ù whatsoever she sitteth šu-ba shall bhū unclean, as sa uncleanness asya ani-munus separation.
api whosoever toucheth those things shall gál unclean, api shall wash asya clothes, u3 bathe himself a udaka, ù gál unclean until bi even.
but if she me cleansed ak asyāḥ issue, then she shall number šè herself seven days, ù after iri she shall me clean.
u3 on eṣa eighth u4 she shall take abhimukham tasyāḥ dvi turtles, or dvau young pigeons, api bring bi-ne šè bi priest, prati sa door asya eṣa tabernacle ak sa congregation.
ù bi priest shall offer tad diš šè a sin offering, u3 bi other šè a burnt offering; api tad priest shall nirmā an atonement arthạm tasyāḥ before eṣa lugal šè tad issue ak ani-munus uncleanness.
thus shall ye separate bi children ak israel tas bi-meš uncleanness; yad they úš nu antar bi-meš uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle iri is among bi-ne.
bi is bi law ak him tad hath an issue, u3 asya him whose seed goeth prabhṛti him, ù is defiled therewith;
u3 ak tasyāḥ yad is sick ak ani-munus flowers, u3 sya him iri hath an issue, sya tad manuṣya, u3 ak sa sal, u3 ak him tad lieth ù tasyāḥ ne is unclean.
ù bi prabhu spake šè moses after bi ug7 sya tad min ibila ak aaron, when they offered before bi svāmin, api died;

ca bi prabhu inim šè moses, speak šè aaron thy brother, yad ani prāp nu at šu times šè bi holy ki within tad vail before bi mercy seat, yaḥ is šu-ba bi ark; ne bi mṛ na: šè i will prakāś a bi cloud ugu bi mercy seat.
thus shall aaron è praviśya bi holy ki: sahita a young bullock šè a sin offering, u3 a ram šè a burnt offering.

eṣa shall put on sa holy linen coat, tathā ayam shall have bi linen breeches par asya flesh, tathā shall as girded sahita a linen girdle, ù saha sa linen mitre shall bi me attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall ani wash tasya flesh a ap, api ittham put bi-ne on.
tathā ani shall take sya bi congregation ak bi children ak israel dvau kids asya eṣa goats kṛte a sin offering, u3 prathama ram arthạm a burnt offering.
tathā aaron shall offer bi bullock sya bi sin offering, yaḥ is šè himself, ù dim an atonement šè himself, u3 kṛte tasya sadana.
ù ani shall take eṣa min goats, ù present etān before eṣa svāmin at bi door ak bi tabernacle ak bi congregation.
api aaron shall cast lots šu-ba bi min goats; diš lot šè eṣa ensi, api tad other lot mu sa scapegoat.
api aaron shall bring bi goat ugu ša tad lord's lot fell, u3 offer him arthạm a sin offering.
but bi goat, on ša bi lot fell abhimukham vṛt eṣa scapegoat, shall bhū presented alive before sa nātha, šè nirmā an atonement ù him, ca šè dā him gam kṛte a scapegoat šè bi wilderness.
ù aaron shall bring bi bullock ak bi sin offering, yad is šè himself, api shall dim an atonement mu himself, u3 šè asya gṛha, ca shall kill eṣa bullock ak sa sin offering lú is arthạm himself:
ca eṣa shall take a censer full asya burning coals ak fire tas off bi altar before bi prabhu, ù ani hands full ak sweet incense beaten small, tathā bring bi within bi vail:
api bi shall put sa incense par eṣa fire before bi prabhu, yad bi cloud ak sa incense may cover bi mercy seat ne is par tad testimony, tad ani ug7 mā:
u3 ani shall take sya eṣa blood ak eṣa bullock, ù sprinkle idam saha tasya finger par bi mercy seat eastward; api before sa mercy seat shall ani sprinkle ak bi blood da bi finger seven times.

then shall ani kill bi goat asya sa sin offering, tad is mu bi ùĝ, ù bring asya blood within sa vail, ca do saha tad blood as ani did sahita sa blood ak bi bullock, api sprinkle bi upari bi mercy seat, u3 before tad mercy seat:

api ani shall kṛ an atonement kṛte eṣa holy ki, because sya bi uncleanness ak eṣa children sya israel, ù because asya eṣām transgressions antar niĝ eṣām sins: ù nu-me shall sa do arthạm bi tabernacle sya tad congregation, iri remaineth among bi-ne a sa murgu ak eṣām uncleanness.

u3 tatra shall as na manuṣya madhye eṣa tabernacle ak eṣa congregation when ayam goeth a abhimukham dim an atonement madhye sa holy šà, until ani è è, ù have dù an atonement mu himself, ù kṛte tasya household, ù mu sakala sa congregation ak israel.

ù sa shall gam bahis šè bi altar yad is before tad svāmin, ca vidh an atonement šè idam; u3 shall take ak eṣa blood sya eṣa bullock, api sya bi blood ak eṣa goat, ca put bi par bi horns ak tad altar round about.
ù ayam shall sprinkle ak bi blood ugu bi saha bi finger seven times, ca cleanse ne, api hallow tat tas bi uncleanness ak bi children asya israel.
ca when sa hath vidh an end ak reconciling bi holy ki, ù tad tabernacle ak eṣa congregation, u3 bi altar, ani shall bring eṣa vas goat:

api aaron shall lay both ani hands par eṣa head ak bi jīv goat, ca confess over him niĝ bi iniquities asya bi children sya israel, ca sakala bi-meš transgressions madhye gištug bi-meš sins, putting etān šu-ba bi head sya eṣa goat, u3 shall send him away by bi hand ak a fit nitadam a bi wilderness:
ca eṣa goat shall bear šu-ba him šu bi-meš iniquities abhimukham a kalam na inhabited: tathā sa shall he-me yā eṣa goat antar bi wilderness.
u3 aaron shall gin a bi tabernacle ak eṣa congregation, ca shall put off sa linen garments, ša ayam put on when eṣa gen praviśya sa holy šà, ca shall leave bi-ne ni:

u3 bi shall wash ani flesh da ap madhye tad holy deśa, tathā put on asya garments, api gin forth, tathā offer bi burnt offering, tathā bi burnt offering ak bi saĝ, ù dim an atonement šè himself, api šè bi loka.
api sa fat ak sa sin offering shall eṣa burn upari tad altar.
ca sa ne anujñā gen eṣa goat arthạm eṣa scapegoat shall wash tasya clothes, api bathe asya flesh madhye ap, api afterward è šè eṣa camp.

u3 tad bullock mu bi sin offering, ca eṣa goat šè eṣa sin offering, whose blood gál brought antar šè kṛ atonement madhye bi holy deśa, shall aš carry forth vinā bi camp; u3 they shall burn a eṣa fire eṣām skins, api bi-meš flesh, ù bi-meš dung.
u3 eṣa yad burneth bi-ne shall wash bi clothes, ù bathe tasya flesh a ap, u3 afterward sa shall āyā praviśya bi camp.

ù etat shall as a statute kṛte ever prati you: ne ša sa seventh month, on tad tenth u4 sya eṣa month, ye shall afflict your souls, ca do na work at viśva, whether bi gál prathama ak your own country, or a stranger iri sojourneth among you:
arthạm on iri ud shall bi priest vidh an atonement kṛte you, šè cleanse you, yad ye may vṛt clean prabhṛti šu your sins before eṣa svāmin.
idam shall me a sabbath asya rest šè you, tathā ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute mu ever.

u3 bi priest, whom ayam shall anoint, ca whom ayam shall consecrate šè minister a bi priest's office madhye tasya father's stead, shall nirmā bi atonement, ù shall put on sa linen clothes, even bi holy garments:

api sa shall dim an atonement mu eṣa holy sanctuary, ca ayam shall kṛ an atonement šè sa tabernacle ak eṣa congregation, tathā mu bi altar, u3 bi shall dim an atonement kṛte tad priests, ù šè sarva bi ukkin sya eṣa congregation.
ù idam shall me an everlasting statute šè you, šè vidh an atonement šè bi children ak israel arthạm sakala eṣām sins once a year. u3 ayam did as bi ensi commanded moses.
ù eṣa svāmin spake šè moses, brū,
speak abhimukham aaron, ù šè tasya ibila, u3 šè sakala tad children sya israel, ù vac šè tān; idam is sa thing yaḥ bi prabhu hath commanded, dug4,
what manuṣya soever ni gál ak eṣa gṛha asya israel, tad killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, antar tad camp, or yad killeth bi bar asya bi camp,

tathā bringeth bi nu šè bi door sya bi tabernacle sya eṣa congregation, šè offer an offering abhimukham eṣa nātha before bi tabernacle ak bi ensi; blood shall as imputed šè ne lú; ani hath shed blood; tathā ne manuṣya shall gál cut off tas among ani ùĝ:

abhimukham bi end yad sa children asya israel may bring bi-meš sacrifices, yad they offer antar bi open field, even tad they may bring etān abhimukham bi nātha, šè bi door ak sa tabernacle sya eṣa congregation, šè eṣa priest, tathā offer etān kṛte peace offerings šè sa en.
ù bi priest shall sprinkle eṣa blood par bi altar ak bi lugal at eṣa door asya tad tabernacle ak bi congregation, ù burn bi fat kṛte a sweet savour šè bi prabhu.
ù they shall na more offer bi-meš sacrifices šè devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. idam shall gál a statute arthạm ever šè etān throughout eṣām generations.
u3 thou shalt inim prati tān, whatsoever puruṣa tatra as sya eṣa gṛha asya israel, or ak bi strangers yaḥ sojourn among you, iri offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
u3 bringeth tat na abhimukham bi door ak bi tabernacle asya tad congregation, abhimukham offer tat šè eṣa prabhu; even tad puruṣa shall as cut off ta among ani loka.

u3 whatsoever guruš atra bhū ak sa ki-gal ak israel, or asya bi strangers ne sojourn among you, iri eateth any manner sya blood; i will even set my mukha against iri soul tad eateth blood, ca will cut him off prabhṛti among ani jana.
šè bi āyus ak eṣa flesh is a bi blood: u3 i have given tat prati you upari tad altar prati gag an atonement mu your souls: šè ne is bi blood tad maketh an atonement kṛte bi soul.
therefore i e abhimukham sa children ak israel, nu soul ak you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger yad sojourneth among you eat blood.

ca whatsoever manuṣya atra vṛt ak eṣa children sya israel, or sya tad strangers yad sojourn among you, yaḥ hunteth ca catcheth any beast or fowl ne may me eaten; eṣa shall even pour bahis bi blood thereof, tathā cover ne da dust.

mu tat is sa jīvana asya šu flesh; bi blood ak bi is arthạm eṣa ti thereof: therefore i vac šè eṣa children sya israel, ye shall eat bi blood asya na manner sya flesh: šè bi ti ak sakala flesh is bi blood thereof: whosoever eateth tat shall as cut off.

tathā every soul tad eateth yad ša died ak itself, or tad yad as torn ù beasts, whether tat me diš ak your own country, or a stranger, sa shall both wash bi clothes, u3 bathe himself ša ídim, ù vṛt unclean until bi even: then shall eṣa me clean.
but if ayam wash etān ul, nor bathe tasya flesh; then bi shall bear bi iniquity.
ù eṣa prabhu spake šè moses, vac,
speak abhimukham sa children ak israel, tathā dug4 abhimukham bi-ne, i am bi lugal your deva.
after sa doings sya bi deśa ak egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye nu do: api after bi doings ak bi kur ak canaan, whither i bring you, shall ye ul do: neither shall ye walk a eṣām ordinances.
ye shall do my judgments, ù keep mine ordinances, šè walk therein: i am bi svāmin your an.
ye shall therefore keep my statutes, u3 my judgments: yaḥ if a lú do, ayam shall vas a bi-ne: i am bi svāmin.
none ak you shall approach prati any iri is near asya kin abhimukham him, prati uncover bi-meš nakedness: i am bi nātha.
eṣa nakedness asya thy father, or bi nakedness asya thy mother, shalt thou ul uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt nu uncover tasyāḥ nakedness.
bi nakedness ak thy father's wife shalt thou ul uncover: bi is thy father's nakedness.
sa nakedness asya thy sister, bi daughter sya thy father, or daughter ak thy mother, whether she as born at home, or born abroad, even teṣām nakedness thou shalt mā uncover.
bi nakedness ak thy son's daughter, or ak thy daughter's daughter, even bi-meš nakedness thou shalt na uncover: mu theirs is thine own nakedness.
bi nakedness ak thy father's wife's daughter, begotten ak thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt nu uncover ani-munus nakedness.
thou shalt nu uncover sa nakedness ak thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
thou shalt ul uncover sa nakedness sya thy mother's sister: šè she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
thou shalt ul uncover bi nakedness sya thy father's brother, thou shalt ul approach prati bi wife: she is thine aunt.
thou shalt mā uncover eṣa nakedness ak thy daughter antar law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt na uncover tasyāḥ nakedness.
thou shalt ul uncover eṣa nakedness ak thy brother's wife: ne is thy brother's nakedness.
