thou shalt na uncover tad nakedness asya a dam api tasyāḥ daughter, neither shalt thou take ani-munus son's daughter, or asyāḥ daughter's daughter, šè uncover asyāḥ nakedness; mu they are tasyāḥ near kinswomen: tat is wickedness.
neither shalt thou take a wife abhimukham ani-munus sister, prati vex ani-munus, prati uncover ani-munus nakedness, beside sa other ša ani-munus nam-ti time.
also thou shalt ul approach šè a sal šè uncover tasyāḥ nakedness, as long as she is put apart mu tasyāḥ uncleanness.
moreover thou shalt nu lie carnally ù thy neighbour's wife, abhimukham defile thyself ù ani-munus.
ca thou shalt mā gá any ak thy seed pass through eṣa fire prati molech, neither shalt thou profane bi name sya thy īśvara: i am sa nātha.
thou shalt na lie sahita mankind, as sahita womankind: tat is abomination.
neither shalt thou lie ù any beast šè defile thyself therewith: neither shall any sal stand before a beast šè lie down thereto: bi is confusion.
defile nu ye yourselves antar any ak these things: kṛte madhye niĝ these sa nations are defiled ša i cast bar before you:
ù bi kalam is defiled: therefore i do visit bi iniquity thereof upari bi, ù eṣa kur itself vomiteth bahis ani-munus inhabitants.
ye shall therefore keep my statutes u3 my judgments, ù shall nu commit any ak these abominations; neither any asya your own nation, nor any stranger ne sojourneth among you:
(for šu these abominations have eṣa men ak bi deśa done, yad bhū before you, ca bi kur is defiled ;)
yad bi kur spue ul you bāhya also, when ye defile ne, as idam spued bahis sa nations yad bhū before you.
šè whosoever shall commit any sya these abominations, even bi souls iri commit bi-ne shall gál cut off tas among eṣām ùĝ.
therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, tad ye commit mā any diš asya these abominable customs, yad vṛt committed before you, ù yad ye defile na yourselves therein: i am bi ensi your īśvara.
api bi ensi spake prati moses, vac,
speak šè sakala bi congregation sya sa children asya israel, ù brū šè etān, ye shall gál holy: arthạm i bi svāmin your bhagavān am holy.
ye shall fear every nara tasya mother, u3 bi father, ca keep my sabbaths: i am bi ensi your an.
turn ye na šè idols, nor dim šè yourselves molten gods: i am bi lugal your bhagavān.
ù if ye offer a sacrifice ak peace offerings šè eṣa lugal, ye shall offer bi at your own will.
bi shall me eaten tad same u4 ye offer tat, ù on eṣa morrow: api if ought remain until sa eš ahar, idam shall bhū burnt madhye bi fire.
u3 if ne vṛt eaten at niĝ on bi 3-kam dina, ne is abominable; bi shall nu me accepted.
therefore every prathama iri eateth ne shall bear asya iniquity, because bi hath profaned bi hallowed thing ak bi en: tathā iri soul shall bhū cut off prabhṛti among asya loka.
u3 when ye reap bi harvest ak your bhū, thou shalt mā wholly reap eṣa corners asya thy field, neither shalt thou saṃgṛh eṣa gleanings sya thy harvest.
api thou shalt ul glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gar every grape sya thy vineyard; thou shalt leave bi-ne arthạm tad poor ù stranger: i am bi svāmin your dingir.
ye shall ul steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie diš abhimukham another.
tathā ye shall mā swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane bi name ak thy bhagavān: i am bi svāmin.
thou shalt nu defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: tad wages ak him yad is hired shall na abide sahita thee sakala rājani until tad prātas.
thou shalt nu curse bi deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before sa blind, but shalt fear thy deva: i am bi svāmin.
ye shall do nu unrighteousness a judgment: thou shalt na respect bi person sya bi poor, nor honor bi person ak bi mighty: but madhye righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
thou shalt nu vraj up tathā down as a talebearer among thy prajā: neither shalt thou stand against bi blood ak thy neighbour: i am sa en.
thou shalt na hate thy brother ša thine heart: thou shalt ša any wise rebuke thy neighbour, u3 ul suffer sin upari him.
thou shalt mā avenge, nor bear any grudge against eṣa children asya thy jana, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: i am bi lugal.
ye shall keep my statutes. thou shalt ul he-me thy cattle gender ù a diverse kind: thou shalt na sow thy field ù mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled ak linen ù woollen prāp šu-ba thee.

ca whosoever lieth carnally ù a sal, tad is a bondmaid, betrothed šè an husband, api mā at niĝ redeemed, nor freedom given tasyāḥ; she shall bhū scourged; they shall nu bhū put prati ug7, because she gál mā free.
ù bi shall bring asya trespass offering šè bi nātha, abhimukham bi door ak eṣa tabernacle ak sa congregation, even a ram kṛte a trespass offering.
api eṣa priest shall nirmā an atonement kṛte him da bi ram asya eṣa trespass offering before bi nātha mu tasya sin lú ayam hath done: u3 bi sin lú ani hath done shall vṛt forgiven him.

ca when ye shall è praviśya bi bhū, u3 shall have planted viśva manner ak trees šè food, then ye shall count eṣa fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall bi bhū as uncircumcised prati you: ne shall mā gál eaten ak.
but antar eṣa fourth year šu eṣa fruit thereof shall bhū holy šè praise tad nātha withal.
ù a bi fifth year shall ye eat ak bi fruit thereof, yad tat may yield šè you sa increase thereof: i am eṣa svāmin your deva.
ye shall ul eat any thing sahita eṣa blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
ye shall ul round tad corners asya your heads, neither shalt thou mar sa corners ak thy beard.
ye shall ul dù any cuttings ša your flesh arthạm bi dead, nor print any marks ugu you: i am bi lugal.
do na prostitute thy daughter, šè cause ani-munus abhimukham gál a whore; lest tad deśa fall prati whoredom, ù bi bhū become full ak wickedness.
ye shall keep my sabbaths, ca reverence my sanctuary: i am bi svāmin.
regard nu bi-ne ne have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, prati as defiled by etān: i am bi nātha your an.
thou shalt rise up before bi hoary head, ca honour bi igi asya bi old nara, ù fear thy deva: i am bi svāmin.
ca if a stranger sojourn saha thee madhye your deśa, ye shall na vex him.
but sa stranger ne dwelleth da you shall me šè you as prathama born among you, ù thou shalt love him as thyself; šè ye as strangers antar eṣa kalam ak egypt: i am bi svāmin your īśvara.
ye shall do nahi unrighteousness a judgment, madhye meteyard, a weight, or antar measure.
just balances, just weights, a just ephah, tathā a just hin, shall ye have: i am tad lugal your bhagavān, lú brought you è sya bi pradeśa ak egypt.
therefore shall ye observe viśva my statutes, ù viśva my judgments, tathā do bi-ne: i am bi en.
u3 sa ensi spake prati moses, vac,

again, thou shalt kathay šè bi children ak israel, whosoever ayam as ak eṣa children asya israel, or sya tad strangers ne sojourn a israel, iri giveth any ak asya seed šè molech; ani shall surely as put prati úš: eṣa saĝ sya sa kalam shall stone him saha stones.
tathā i will set my pa against tad guruš, u3 will cut him off ta among bi saĝ; because ani hath given ak tasya seed prati molech, šè defile my sanctuary, u3 šè profane my holy name.
ca if sa prajā ak bi pradeśa do any ways hide bi-meš eyes tas sa nitadam, when bi giveth ak ani seed prati molech, u3 kill him mā:
then i will set my mukha against iri puruṣa, u3 against asya family, u3 will cut him off, ù sakala tad yā a whoring after him, abhimukham commit whoredom sahita molech, ta among bi-meš loka.
ca eṣa soul tad turneth after such as have familiar spirits, u3 after wizards, abhimukham è a whoring after bi-ne, i will even set my igi against tad soul, ù will cut him off ta among tasya jana.
sanctify yourselves therefore, ù me ye holy: kṛte i am bi prabhu your ilum.
ca ye shall keep my statutes, ù do bi-ne: i am bi en yad sanctify you.
šè every aš iri curseth asya father or tasya mother shall me surely put šè maraṇa: ayam hath cursed ani father or bi mother; asya blood shall vṛt par him.
tathā tad guruš ne committeth adultery ù another man's wife, even ayam iri committeth adultery sahita asya neighbour's wife, bi adulterer tathā bi adulteress shall surely as put šè kāla.
tathā sa nara iri lieth da asya father's wife hath uncovered ani father's nakedness: both ak bi-ne shall surely bhū put abhimukham maraṇa; eṣām blood shall me par bi-ne.
u3 if a nara lie da asya daughter ša law, both ak bi-ne shall surely gál put prati úš: they have wrought confusion; eṣām blood shall me šu-ba tān.
if a puruṣa also lie ù mankind, as bi lieth ù a munus, both ak bi-ne have committed an abomination: they shall surely gál put prati úš; teṣām blood shall gál upari etān.
ù if a puruṣa take a wife ca asyāḥ mother, ne is wickedness: they shall gál burnt sahita fire, both bi ca they; iri ne me nu wickedness among you.
tathā if a nara lie ù a beast, bi shall surely as put šè ug7: tathā ye shall slay bi beast.
ca if a sal approach prati any beast, api lie down thereto, thou shalt kill tad sal, tathā bi beast: they shall surely me put prati maraṇa; bi-meš blood shall me ugu bi-ne.

ù if a guruš shall take asya sister, tasya father's daughter, or asya mother's daughter, tathā dṛś tasyāḥ nakedness, api she paś asya nakedness; ne is a wicked thing; api they shall me cut off madhye bi sight asya bi-meš prajā: ayam hath uncovered ani sister's nakedness; ani shall bear tasya iniquity.

ca if a lú shall lie saha a strī having ani-munus sickness, u3 shall uncover ani-munus nakedness; ayam hath discovered tasyāḥ fountain, ca she hath uncovered sa fountain asya ani-munus blood: u3 both ak bi-ne shall gál cut off ta among eṣām loka.
u3 thou shalt nu uncover bi nakedness asya thy mother's sister, nor ak thy father's sister: šè ani uncovereth bi near kin: they shall bear bi-meš iniquity.
u3 if a puruṣa shall lie ù ani uncle's wife, bi hath uncovered ani uncle's nakedness: they shall bear bi-meš sin; they shall ug7 childless.
tathā if a guruš shall take bi brother's wife, bi is an unclean thing: ani hath uncovered tasya brother's nakedness; they shall as childless.
ye shall therefore keep gištug my statutes, api sakala my judgments, tathā do tān: ne sa pradeśa, whither i bring you abhimukham dwell therein, spue you ul bāhya.
ca ye shall na walk a bi manners asya tad nation, ša i cast bāhya before you: kṛte they committed niĝ these things, tathā therefore i abhorred tān.
but i have dug4 šè you, ye shall inherit eṣām pradeśa, ù i will give idam šè you šè possess bi, a kur ne floweth da milk ù honey: i am eṣa ensi your īśvara, ša have separated you ta other loka.

ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts u3 unclean, tathā between unclean fowls api clean: ca ye shall nu kṛ your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner sya living thing tad creepeth on bi ground, ša i have separated prabhṛti you as unclean.
ù ye shall as holy šè me: šè i bi prabhu am holy, ca have severed you prabhṛti other loka, ne ye should gál mine.
a nara also or yoṣit tad hath a familiar prāṇa, or iri is a wizard, shall surely vṛt put šè úš: they shall stone etān saha stones: teṣām blood shall bhū šu-ba bi-ne.
u3 eṣa svāmin kathay šè moses, speak abhimukham sa priests eṣa putra ak aaron, u3 vac šè bi-ne, atra shall none me defiled šè sa dead among asya ukkin:
but kṛte asya kin, iri is near abhimukham him, ne is, mu asya mother, u3 arthạm asya father, ù kṛte asya putra, api kṛte bi daughter, ca šè asya brother,
api arthạm bi sister a virgin, ne is nigh šè him, yaḥ hath had nu husband; kṛte ani-munus may ani me defiled.
but eṣa shall na defile himself, being a chief nitadam among asya loka, prati profane himself.
they shall mā dim baldness šu-ba bi-meš head, neither shall they shave off sa corner asya teṣām beard, nor kṛ any cuttings a bi-meš flesh.
they shall vṛt holy šè bi-meš ilum, ca ul profane bi name ak bi-meš īśvara: šè bi offerings ak tad ensi dù by fire, u3 eṣa bread ak bi-meš bhagavān, they do offer: therefore they shall gál holy.
they shall na take a wife yad is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a yoṣit put away tas ani-munus husband: mu ani is holy prati tasya dingir.
thou shalt sanctify him therefore; mu ayam offereth bi bread asya thy ilum: bi shall gál holy prati thee: šè i bi prabhu, ša sanctify you, am holy.
ù eṣa daughter ak any priest, if she profane herself by playing sa whore, she profaneth ani-munus father: she shall as burnt ù fire.

api sa yad is bi high priest among tasya brethren, ugu whose head bi anointing oil vṛt poured, u3 iri is consecrated abhimukham put on sa garments, shall na uncover tasya head, nor rend tasya clothes;
neither shall sa è madhye abhimukham any dead body, nor defile himself šè bi father, or šè ani mother;
neither shall sa du bahis sya bi sanctuary, nor profane eṣa sanctuary sya asya deva; kṛte eṣa crown ak tad anointing oil asya tasya ilum is šu-ba him: i am tad nātha.
u3 sa shall take a wife madhye tasyāḥ virginity.
a widow, or a divorced munus, or profane, or an harlot, these shall ani mā take: but eṣa shall take a virgin ak ani own saĝ prati wife.
neither shall bi profane asya seed among ani saĝ: mu i bi ensi do sanctify him.
u3 bi ensi spake šè moses, vac,
speak šè aaron, kathay, whosoever eṣa gál ak thy seed ša bi-meš generations iri hath any blemish, anujñā him mā approach šè offer eṣa bread sya tasya īśvara.
mu whatsoever lú ayam vṛt yad hath a blemish, ayam shall nu approach: a blind puruṣa, or a lame, or ayam tad hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,
or a guruš yad is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,
or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or iri hath a blemish antar ani eye, or me scurvy, or scabbed, or hath bi stones broken;

na manuṣya ne hath a blemish asya sa seed ak aaron eṣa priest shall gin nigh šè offer bi offerings ak bi nātha dù by fire: bi hath a blemish; bi shall ul ā-gam nigh prati offer eṣa bread ak ani dingir.
ani shall eat eṣa bread sya ani an, both sya bi most holy, ca ak bi holy.
only bi shall na yā a šè bi vail, nor du nigh abhimukham sa altar, because bi hath a blemish; ne ani profane nu my sanctuaries: mu i bi svāmin do sanctify etān.
api moses told tat šè aaron, ca prati tasya ibila, ù abhimukham viśva sa children ak israel.
api eṣa prabhu spake prati moses, brū,

speak prati aaron tathā abhimukham ani putra, tad they separate themselves tas bi holy things ak sa children ak israel, tathā ne they profane na my holy name a those things lú they hallow šè me: i am sa en.

inim abhimukham tān, whosoever bi vṛt ak sakala your seed among your generations, ne goeth abhimukham bi holy things, yaḥ bi children asya israel hallow abhimukham eṣa svāmin, having asya uncleanness ugu him, ne soul shall bhū cut off ta my presence: i am sa prabhu.

what nara soever ak eṣa seed ak aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; ayam shall ul eat ak eṣa holy things, until sa gál clean. u3 whoso toucheth any thing ne is unclean by bi dead, or a puruṣa whose seed goeth prabhṛti him;
or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby ani may gál gag unclean, or a manuṣya ak whom bi may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness bi hath;
eṣa soul yaḥ hath touched any such shall gál unclean until even, ù shall mā eat asya tad holy things, unless eṣa wash asya flesh da a.
tathā when bi sun is down, sa shall vṛt clean, ù shall afterward eat asya bi holy things; because tat is tasya food.
tad ša dieth ak itself, or is torn da beasts, bi shall na eat šè defile himself therewith: i am bi en.
they shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin kṛte ne, u3 ug7 therefore, if they profane tat: i tad svāmin do sanctify tān.
atra shall nu stranger eat sya eṣa holy thing: a sojourner ak bi priest, or an hired servant, shall mā eat sya bi holy thing.
but if bi priest buy any soul da bi money, ayam shall eat ak ne, ù sa yad is born madhye bi sadana: they shall eat asya tasya meat.
if tad priest's daughter also me married abhimukham a stranger, she may na eat ak an offering ak eṣa holy things.

but if eṣa priest's daughter gál a widow, or divorced, api have na child, api is returned abhimukham asyāḥ father's geh, as a ani-munus youth, she shall eat asya ani-munus father's meat: but tatra shall na stranger eat thereof.
u3 if a guruš eat ak tad holy thing unwittingly, then ani shall put bi fifth part thereof prati idam, ù shall give tat abhimukham tad priest da eṣa holy thing.
ù they shall na profane tad holy things sya bi children ak israel, yaḥ they offer šè bi lugal;
or suffer etān prati bear tad iniquity sya trespass, when they eat eṣām holy things: arthạm i bi ensi do sanctify bi-ne.
u3 tad prabhu spake šè moses, brū,

speak šè aaron, tathā šè bi suta, tathā šè sarva bi children asya israel, api vac šè bi-ne, whatsoever ayam gál asya bi geh asya israel, or ak bi strangers madhye israel, iri will offer tasya oblation kṛte šu ani vows, u3 kṛte viśva tasya freewill offerings, yaḥ they will offer šè eṣa lugal mu a burnt offering;
ye shall offer at your own will a male vinā blemish, sya bi beeves, sya tad sheep, or asya eṣa goats.
but whatsoever hath a blemish, yad shall ye nu offer: kṛte idam shall mā vṛt acceptable kṛte you.

tathā whosoever offereth a sacrifice asya peace offerings abhimukham bi prabhu abhimukham accomplish tasya vow, or a freewill offering madhye beeves or sheep, ne shall me perfect prati me accepted; ni shall me nu blemish therein.
blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall nu offer these abhimukham eṣa ensi, nor dù an offering by fire ak bi-ne par bi altar abhimukham sa svāmin.
either a bullock or a lamb ne hath any thing superfluous or lacking a bi parts, iri mayest thou offer kṛte a freewill offering; but arthạm a vow bi shall mā me accepted.
ye shall nu offer šè tad en ne ša is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye gag any offering thereof madhye your deśa.
neither ta a stranger's hand shall ye offer bi bread ak your an asya any ak these; because eṣām corruption is antar bi-ne, u3 blemishes as a tān: they shall nu me accepted mu you.
ca bi lugal spake abhimukham moses, brū,

when a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then ne shall bhū seven days kur eṣa dam; api prabhṛti sa eighth divasa u3 thenceforth bi shall gál accepted mu an offering dù by fire šè sa svāmin.
api whether bi me cow or ewe, ye shall na kill ne ù tasyāḥ young both ša aš ud.
api when ye will offer a sacrifice asya thanksgiving prati eṣa ensi, offer ne at your own will.
on tad same u4 bi shall vṛt eaten up; ye shall leave none ak bi until sa morrow: i am bi lugal.
therefore shall ye keep my commandments, tathā do etān: i am sa nātha.
neither shall ye profane my holy name; but i will gál hallowed among bi children sya israel: i am eṣa nātha yad hallow you,
iri brought you bar sya bi pradeśa ak egypt, abhimukham me your īśvara: i am bi lugal.
api bi svāmin spake prati moses, kathay,
speak abhimukham bi children ak israel, tathā brū šè bi-ne, concerning eṣa feasts asya sa ensi, lú ye shall proclaim prati bhū holy convocations, even these are my feasts.
six days shall work gál done: but bi seventh dina is bi sabbath ak rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do nu work therein: ne is eṣa sabbath asya eṣa svāmin a sarva your dwellings.
these are eṣa feasts ak bi lugal, even holy convocations, lú ye shall proclaim madhye bi-meš seasons.
antar eṣa fourteenth divasa ak bi 1-kam month at even is tad lord's passover.
api on tad fifteenth u4 sya bi same month is bi feast ak unleavened bread šè eṣa prabhu: seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.
a tad ādya dina ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do nu servile work therein.
but ye shall offer an offering gag by fire abhimukham bi ensi seven days: antar tad seventh u4 is an holy convocation: ye shall do na servile work therein.
ù sa en spake šè moses, inim,

speak šè bi children ak israel, ù vac abhimukham etān, when ye me ā-gam a sa bhū yad i give šè you, api shall reap eṣa harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf sya eṣa firstfruits sya your harvest prati eṣa priest:
u3 ani shall wave tad sheaf before bi lugal, šè as accepted arthạm you: on bi morrow after bi sabbath bi priest shall wave idam.
ca ye shall offer iri dina when ye wave bi sheaf an bi lamb ul blemish ak bi imin year mu a burnt offering šè bi lugal.

ù bi meat offering thereof shall vṛt dvi tenth deals ak fine flour mingled ù oil, an offering kṛ by fire šè tad en arthạm a sweet savour: u3 eṣa drink offering thereof shall as ak wine, sa fourth part asya an hin.

u3 ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until sa selfsame divasa tad ye have brought an offering abhimukham your īśvara: idam shall vṛt a statute šè ever throughout your generations madhye viśva your dwellings.
u3 ye shall count šè you tas bi morrow after bi sabbath, tas eṣa ud yad ye brought bi sheaf asya eṣa wave offering; seven sabbaths shall gál complete:
even šè bi morrow after bi seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; u3 ye shall offer a new meat offering abhimukham tad en.
ye shall bring è ak your habitations dvi wave loaves ak dvau tenth deals: they shall bhū ak fine flour; they shall me baken saha leaven; they are eṣa firstfruits prati bi nātha.

ù ye shall offer da sa bread seven lambs vinā blemish asya tad ādya year, u3 diš young bullock, tathā dvau rams: they shall bhū šè a burnt offering abhimukham bi en, sahita teṣām meat offering, u3 teṣām drink offerings, even an offering gag by fire, sya sweet savour šè bi nātha.
then ye shall sacrifice prathama kid ak tad goats arthạm a sin offering, ù dvi lambs sya eṣa prathama year šè a sacrifice sya peace offerings.
ca bi priest shall wave etān ù tad bread asya bi firstfruits arthạm a wave offering before bi nātha, da eṣa min lambs: they shall vṛt holy šè bi prabhu kṛte bi priest.

api ye shall proclaim on bi selfsame ahar, iri tat may me an holy convocation abhimukham you: ye shall do nahi servile work therein: tat shall bhū a statute arthạm ever antar gištug your dwellings throughout your generations.

api when ye reap bi harvest ak your kalam, thou shalt mā dim clean riddance sya eṣa corners asya thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gar any gleaning ak thy harvest: thou shalt leave etān abhimukham bi poor, ca prati eṣa stranger: i am bi en your īśvara.
ù sa en spake šè moses, e,
speak šè bi children ak israel, kathay, ša sa seventh month, antar eṣa ādya u4 sya sa month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial asya blowing ak trumpets, an holy convocation.
ye shall do na servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering vidh by fire abhimukham bi svāmin.
ù bi nātha spake abhimukham moses, brū,

also on bi tenth dina asya idam seventh month tatra shall as a ud asya atonement: idam shall bhū an holy convocation šè you; u3 ye shall afflict your souls, ù offer an offering gag by fire šè bi nātha.
ca ye shall do na work ša yad same u4: mu bi is a u4 sya atonement, abhimukham kṛ an atonement arthạm you before bi en your īśvara.
šè whatsoever soul bi me yad shall ul bhū afflicted a yad same u4, ayam shall me cut off prabhṛti among ani jana.
ù whatsoever soul bi bhū ne doeth any work a tad same ahar, bi same soul will i destroy tas among ani ùĝ.
ye shall do nu manner sya work: ne shall me a statute kṛte ever throughout your generations antar viśva your dwellings.
ne shall gál šè you a sabbath asya rest, u3 ye shall afflict your souls: ša sa ninth ud asya bi month at even, prabhṛti even prati even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.
ù sa nātha spake prati moses, inim,
speak prati eṣa children asya israel, e, tad fifteenth ahar sya ne seventh month shall me tad feast asya tabernacles mu seven days šè sa ensi.
on eṣa ādya divasa shall vṛt an holy convocation: ye shall do nu servile work therein.

seven days ye shall offer an offering vidh by fire šè sa en: on bi eighth u4 shall as an holy convocation šè you; u3 ye shall offer an offering dù by fire prati eṣa lugal: tat is a solemn assembly; tathā ye shall do nu servile work therein.

these are bi feasts ak tad ensi, lú ye shall proclaim šè me holy convocations, šè offer an offering nirmā by fire prati sa nātha, a burnt offering, ca a meat offering, a sacrifice, ù drink offerings, every thing par tasya u4:
beside bi sabbaths asya eṣa svāmin, u3 beside your gifts, u3 beside viśva your vows, ca beside viśva your freewill offerings, yaḥ ye give šè bi prabhu.

also a eṣa fifteenth u4 ak tad seventh month, when ye have saṃgṛh madhye bi fruit ak bi kalam, ye shall keep a feast šè sa nātha seven days: on bi ādya u4 shall gál a sabbath, api on eṣa eighth u4 shall gál a sabbath.

u3 ye shall take you on bi prathama u4 tad boughs sya goodly trees, branches sya palm trees, tathā eṣa boughs sya thick trees, u3 willows asya tad brook; tathā ye shall rejoice before tad ensi your dingir seven days.
api ye shall keep ne a feast abhimukham bi nātha seven days madhye eṣa year. ne shall me a statute mu ever antar your generations: ye shall celebrate bi madhye sa seventh month.
ye shall dwell ša booths seven days; gištug tad are israelites born shall dwell a booths:
iri your generations may know tad i gag eṣa children ak israel šè dwell antar booths, when i brought etān è ak bi kur ak egypt: i am sa en your bhagavān.
ca moses declared abhimukham bi children asya israel bi feasts ak bi svāmin.
api tad prabhu spake prati moses, brū,
command bi children ak israel, iri they bring abhimukham thee pure oil olive beaten arthạm eṣa ud, prati cause tad lamps šè burn continually.

rahita eṣa vail asya sa testimony, madhye bi tabernacle ak tad congregation, shall aaron order idam prabhṛti sa sāyam prati eṣa uṣas before sa ensi continually: tat shall me a statute šè ever a your generations.
sa shall order sa lamps par bi pure candlestick before bi en continually.
ca thou shalt take fine flour, u3 bake twelve cakes thereof: min tenth deals shall me a aš cake.
ca thou shalt set bi-ne ša dvi rows, six on a row, par sa pure table before eṣa en.
ù thou shalt put pure frankincense šu-ba each row, ne tat may gál on sa bread šè a memorial, even an offering dù by fire abhimukham bi lugal.
every sabbath bi shall set ne antar order before eṣa lugal continually, being taken ta sa children ak israel by an everlasting covenant.
tathā tat shall gál aaron's ù tasya sons'; ù they shall eat ne a sa holy deśa: arthạm bi is most holy šè him asya bi offerings ak bi en vidh by fire by a perpetual statute.
u3 tad ātmaja ak an israelitish strī, whose father as an egyptian, è bahis among eṣa children asya israel: ù etat ātmaja sya eṣa israelitish munus ca a guruš ak israel strove ús antar bi camp;
u3 bi israelitish woman's dumu blasphemed bi name ak tad nātha, ù cursed. ù they brought him šè moses: (and asya mother's name as shelomith, eṣa daughter ak dibri, asya bi tribe sya dan :)
ca they put him antar ward, tad bi mind ak sa prabhu might vṛt shewed bi-ne.
tathā bi ensi spake šè moses, vac,
bring forth him iri hath cursed nu bi camp; u3 anujñā sakala iri heard him lay bi-meš hands šu-ba tasya head, ca gá viśva tad congregation stone him.
tathā thou shalt speak šè bi children asya israel, dug4, whosoever curseth ani bhagavān shall bear asya sin.

u3 ani ne blasphemeth eṣa name ak tad nātha, eṣa shall surely gál put prati úš, u3 gištug bi congregation shall certainly stone him: as well bi stranger, as bi yad is born madhye sa kalam, when ayam blasphemeth eṣa name sya tad ensi, shall me put prati kāla.
tathā ani tad killeth any guruš shall surely vṛt put šè kāla.
api bi yad killeth a beast shall dù ne silim; beast kṛte beast.
tathā if a puruṣa cause a blemish madhye asya neighbour; as eṣa hath done, ittham shall tat vṛt done šè him;
breach mu breach, eye arthạm eye, tooth šè tooth: as ayam hath caused a blemish a a puruṣa, nu-me shall ne bhū done abhimukham him again.
ca ani yad killeth a beast, ani shall restore tat: ca sa yad killeth a manuṣya, eṣa shall gál put prati úš.
ye shall have prathama manner ak law, as well kṛte bi stranger, as arthạm aš ak your own country: kṛte i am bi en your an.
u3 moses spake abhimukham eṣa children ak israel, yad they should bring forth him ne had cursed bar ak eṣa camp, ù stone him saha stones. u3 bi children asya israel did as bi ensi commanded moses.
ù bi prabhu spake abhimukham moses ša mount sinai, brū,
speak abhimukham eṣa children ak israel, ca brū abhimukham etān, when ye du šè eṣa kalam lú i give you, then shall bi bhū keep a sabbath prati bi ensi.
six years thou shalt sow thy field, u3 six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, ù šum ša bi fruit thereof;
but a bi seventh year shall bhū a sabbath asya rest šè bi kur, a sabbath mu tad prabhu: thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.
tad yaḥ groweth sya its own accord ak thy harvest thou shalt mā reap, neither gar eṣa grapes asya thy vine undressed: šè idam is a year ak rest prati eṣa kur.
ù bi sabbath ak tad kur shall bhū meat šè you; arthạm thee, ù arthạm thy servant, ca arthạm thy maid, u3 šè thy hired servant, u3 šè thy stranger iri sojourneth saha thee,
api arthạm thy cattle, u3 šè eṣa beast tad are ša thy pradeśa, shall sakala eṣa increase thereof as meat.
ù thou shalt number seven sabbaths ak years šè thee, seven times seven years; ù bi space asya eṣa seven sabbaths asya years shall gál abhimukham thee forty u3 nine years.
then shalt thou cause bi trumpet ak tad jubile prati sound on eṣa tenth ud asya bi seventh month, ša eṣa divasa ak atonement shall ye gag bi trumpet sound throughout sarva your pradeśa.

u3 ye shall hallow bi fiftieth year, u3 proclaim liberty throughout viśva eṣa bhū abhimukham viśva eṣa inhabitants thereof: ne shall me a jubile šè you; ca ye shall return every nara šè tasya possession, u3 ye shall return every lú prati ani family.
a jubile shall tad fiftieth year gál šè you: ye shall nu sow, neither reap tad ša groweth sya itself a tat, nor šum sa grapes a bi sya thy vine undressed.
šè ne is bi jubile; ne shall me holy abhimukham you: ye shall eat tad increase thereof bar sya bi field.
madhye bi year asya idam jubile ye shall return every lú šè bi possession.
ca if thou sell ought šè thy neighbour, or buyest ought ak thy neighbour's hand, ye shall mā oppress prathama another:
according prati bi number sya years after bi jubile thou shalt buy asya thy neighbour, ù according šè eṣa number ak years sya bi fruits bi shall sell abhimukham thee:

according šè bi multitude ak years thou shalt increase sa price thereof, api according šè bi fewness asya years thou shalt diminish bi price asya bi: kṛte according abhimukham bi number sya bi years ak tad fruits doth ayam sell abhimukham thee.
ye shall ul therefore oppress prathama another; but thou shalt fear thy deva arthạm i am tad svāmin your an.
wherefore ye shall do my statutes, tathā keep my judgments, ù do tān; ca ye shall dwell antar bi bhū ša safety.
ù tad kalam shall yield tasyāḥ fruit, tathā ye shall eat your fill, u3 dwell therein antar safety.
ù if ye shall dug4, what shall we eat eṣa seventh year? behold, we shall ul sow, nor saṃgṛh ša our increase:
then i will command my blessing par you madhye bi sixth year, ca bi shall bring forth fruit kṛte three years.
u3 ye shall sow eṣa eighth year, u3 eat yet ak old fruit until eṣa ninth year; until ani-munus fruits prāp madhye ye shall eat ak tad old store.
bi bhū shall na as sold mu ever: kṛte eṣa kur is mine; kṛte ye are strangers tathā sojourners ù me.
ca madhye viśva eṣa pradeśa sya your possession ye shall grant a redemption mu bi pradeśa.
if thy brother me waxen poor, ù hath sold away some asya asya possession, api if any asya tasya kin gin šè redeem ne, then shall bi redeem yad yad asya brother sold.
ù if tad manuṣya have none prati redeem tat, api himself me able abhimukham redeem ne;
then gá him count sa years sya bi sale thereof, tathā restore eṣa overplus šè eṣa nitadam šè whom bi sold bi; yad ayam may return prati asya possession.

but if sa as na able abhimukham restore ne šè him, then yad ša is sold shall remain antar bi hand ak him yad hath bought tat until bi year ak jubile: tathā ša bi jubile ne shall gam bahis, ù ani shall return prati ani possession.
ca if a nitadam sell a dwelling ki-gal ša a walled city, then ayam may redeem idam within a whole year after idam is sold; within a full year may bi redeem ne.

api if tat as mā redeemed within bi space ak a full year, then eṣa geh tad is ša bi walled city shall me established mu ever šè him iri bought bi throughout tasya generations: tat shall ul gen bar antar eṣa jubile.
but bi houses sya tad villages lú have nu wall round about bi-ne shall bhū counted as eṣa fields asya bi country: they may vṛt redeemed, ca they shall è bāhya madhye bi jubile.
notwithstanding bi cities asya eṣa levites, ù bi houses sya bi cities ak bi-meš possession, may sa levites redeem at any time.

tathā if a puruṣa purchase sya bi levites, then bi ki-gal tad me sold, ù eṣa city asya ani possession, shall yā bāhya a bi year ak jubile: arthạm bi houses ak bi cities asya bi levites are bi-meš possession among tad children sya israel.
but bi field asya bi suburbs sya bi-meš cities may ul me sold; šè bi is eṣām perpetual possession.
ù if thy brother as waxen poor, u3 fallen a decay da thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though ani as a stranger, or a sojourner; iri sa may jīv sahita thee.
take thou nahi usury ak him, or increase: but fear thy bhagavān; iri thy brother may til saha thee.
thou shalt nu give him thy money ugu usury, nor lend him thy victuals arthạm increase.
i am bi nātha your dingir, lú brought you forth bar sya bi kalam sya egypt, šè give you bi pradeśa ak canaan, api šè vṛt your ilum.
tathā if thy brother tad dwelleth by thee vṛt waxen poor, api bhū sold abhimukham thee; thou shalt nu compel him šè serve as a bondservant:
but as an hired servant, u3 as a sojourner, bi shall me ù thee, ca shall serve thee abhimukham bi year ak jubile:
api then shall bi depart ta thee, both ani ca bi children sahita him, api shall return šè tasya own family, tathā prati bi possession asya tasya fathers shall ayam return.
kṛte they are my servants, ša i brought forth bāhya sya bi kur ak egypt: they shall na vṛt sold as bondmen.
thou shalt na rule over him ù rigour; but shalt fear thy deva.
both thy bondmen, ù thy bondmaids, ša thou shalt have, shall bhū asya bi heathen yad are round about you; asya bi-ne shall ye buy bondmen u3 bondmaids.
moreover sya tad children ak bi strangers tad do sojourn among you, sya bi-ne shall ye buy, u3 ak bi-meš families iri are da you, lú they begat antar your deśa: u3 they shall vṛt your possession.

u3 ye shall take bi-ne as an inheritance arthạm your children after you, šè inherit etān kṛte a possession; they shall bhū your bondmen arthạm ever: but over your brethren bi children ak israel, ye shall ul rule prathama over another sahita rigour.
u3 if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, u3 thy brother yad dwelleth by him wax poor, ca sell himself šè eṣa stranger or sojourner by thee, or šè bi stock ak bi stranger's family:
after tad bi is sold bi may me redeemed again; eka ak asya brethren may redeem him:
either tasya uncle, or ani uncle's dumu, may redeem him, or any yad is nigh sya kin šè him ak asya family may redeem him; or if ani gál able, ani may redeem himself.

u3 ayam shall reckon da him yad bought him ta bi year ne ayam vṛt sold abhimukham him abhimukham eṣa year sya jubile: u3 tad price sya ani sale shall me according šè sa number ak years, according šè bi time asya an hired servant shall bi bhū da him.
if atra gál yet many years behind, according prati etān ayam shall give again bi price ak ani redemption è asya bi money iri ani gál bought arthạm.
u3 if ni remain but few years šè eṣa year asya jubile, then sa shall count sahita him, api according abhimukham bi years shall sa give him again tad price asya bi redemption.
u3 as a yearly hired servant shall eṣa me sahita him: api bi other shall na rule ù rigour over him ša thy sight.
ù if bi me na redeemed a these years, then eṣa shall gam è antar tad year ak jubile, both bi, api asya children da him.
kṛte prati me tad children ak israel are servants; they are my servants whom i brought forth è sya sa kalam ak egypt: i am eṣa en your deva.
ye shall vidh you nu idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image asya stone a your kur, šè bow down prati ne: šè i am bi nātha your ilum.
ye shall keep my sabbaths, api reverence my sanctuary: i am eṣa en.
if ye walk ša my statutes, ca keep my commandments, api do tān;
then i will give you rain ša due season, api bi kalam shall yield ani-munus increase, ù sa trees ak sa field shall yield eṣām fruit.
tathā your threshing shall reach prati sa vintage, ca sa vintage shall reach abhimukham bi sowing time: tathā ye shall eat your bread abhimukham bi full, u3 dwell madhye your kur safely.
ca i will give peace a eṣa kalam, api ye shall lie down, ù none shall dim you afraid: u3 i will rid evil beasts è ak sa bhū, neither shall bi sword gen through your pradeśa.
ca ye shall chase your enemies, api they shall fall before you by sa sword.
api five asya you shall chase an hundred, ù an hundred ak you shall put ten thousand šè flight: tathā your enemies shall fall before you by eṣa sword.
arthạm i will have respect abhimukham you, u3 dim you fruitful, ca multiply you, api establish my covenant da you.
tathā ye shall eat old store, u3 bring forth tad old because ak bi new.
ù i will set my tabernacle among you: u3 my soul shall mā abhor you.
api i will walk among you, ca will gál your bhagavān, api ye shall gál my ukkin.
i am bi en your īśvara, yaḥ brought you forth è asya tad kur asya egypt, tad ye should mā gál bi-meš bondmen; u3 i have broken bi bands ak your yoke, ù nirmā you yā upright.
but if ye will ul hearken abhimukham me, api will ul do sakala these commandments;
u3 if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, ga-nam iri ye will mā do sakala my commandments, but ne ye break my covenant:

i also will do bi šè you; i will even appoint over you terror, consumption, api bi burning ague, tad shall consume bi eyes, u3 cause sorrow ak heart: ù ye shall sow your seed madhye vain, kṛte your enemies shall eat bi.
tathā i will set my mukha against you, u3 ye shall gál slain before your enemies: they yad hate you shall reign over you; u3 ye shall flee when none pursueth you.
ù if ye will ul yet arthạm viśva ne hearken abhimukham me, then i will punish you seven times more kṛte your sins.
ca i will break bi pride ak your power; api i will vidh your svarga as iron, tathā your pṛthivī as brass:
ù your strength shall me spent ša vain: arthạm your kalam shall na yield ani-munus increase, neither shall eṣa trees sya bi deśa yield eṣām fruits.
tathā if ye walk contrary šè me, tathā will na hearken prati me; i will bring seven times more plagues upari you according šè your sins.
i will also send wild beasts among you, yaḥ shall rob you ak your children, u3 destroy your cattle, ca dù you few a number; tathā your high ways shall gál desolate.
u3 if ye will mā gál reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary abhimukham me;
then will i also walk contrary abhimukham you, ù will punish you yet seven times mu your sins.

api i will bring a sword ugu you, yad shall avenge bi quarrel sya my covenant: ca when ye are sañcay saṃyuktam within your cities, i will send sa pestilence among you; ca ye shall gál delivered a eṣa hand ak bi enemy.
u3 when i have broken tad staff sya your bread, ten women shall bake your bread a diš oven, ca they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: tathā ye shall eat, ù na as satisfied.
api if ye will ul šè sakala bi hearken abhimukham me, but walk contrary abhimukham me;
then i will walk contrary šè you also antar fury; u3 i, even i, will chastise you seven times mu your sins.
u3 ye shall eat bi flesh ak your suta, tathā eṣa flesh sya your daughters shall ye eat.
api i will destroy your high places, tathā cut down your images, ù cast your carcases šu-ba bi carcases sya your idols, ù my soul shall abhor you.
ù i will dù your cities waste, tathā bring your sanctuaries abhimukham desolation, api i will nu smell bi savour asya your sweet odours.
ù i will bring eṣa pradeśa a desolation: api your enemies lú dwell therein shall me astonished at idam.
ca i will scatter you among tad heathen, api will draw è a sword after you: tathā your kalam shall gál desolate, ù your cities waste.
then shall tad kalam enjoy ani-munus sabbaths, as long as ne lieth desolate, tathā ye me antar your enemies' kur; even then shall bi kalam rest, u3 enjoy tasyāḥ sabbaths.
as long as idam lieth desolate bi shall rest; because idam did ul rest madhye your sabbaths, when ye dwelt par tat.

ca upari etān tad are left alive ak you i will send a faintness a bi-meš hearts madhye eṣa lands asya eṣām enemies; ù sa sound asya a shaken leaf shall chase bi-ne; ù they shall flee, as fleeing tas a sword; u3 they shall fall when none pursueth.
tathā they shall fall aš par another, as bi vṛt before a sword, when none pursueth: api ye shall have nahi power abhimukham stand before your enemies.
u3 ye shall perish among bi heathen, ca tad kalam ak your enemies shall eat you up.
ca they iri are left sya you shall pine away madhye teṣām iniquity a your enemies' lands; api also a eṣa iniquities sya eṣām fathers shall they pine away da tān.
if they shall confess bi-meš iniquity, ù eṣa iniquity ak teṣām fathers, da teṣām trespass yad they trespassed against me, u3 yad also they have walked contrary šè me;

api tad i also have walked contrary šè tān, ca have brought bi-ne antar tad bhū sya bi-meš enemies; if then teṣām uncircumcised hearts gál humbled, ca they then accept ak sa punishment asya eṣām iniquity:
then will i remember my covenant ù jacob, api also my covenant sahita isaac, u3 also my covenant da abraham will i remember; ù i will remember sa kalam.

bi deśa also shall me left ak bi-ne, api shall enjoy tasyāḥ sabbaths, while she lieth desolate rahita bi-ne: ù they shall accept asya tad punishment ak bi-meš iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, ca because eṣām soul abhorred my statutes.

ù yet kṛte niĝ tad, when they bhū a bi pradeśa ak bi-meš enemies, i will nu cast tān away, neither will i abhor tān, šè destroy bi-ne utterly, ca šè break my covenant da bi-ne: mu i am eṣa svāmin teṣām ilum.
but i will šè eṣām sakes remember bi covenant sya bi-meš ancestors, whom i brought forth bahis sya eṣa kur ak egypt ša sa sight ak bi heathen, yad i might me bi-meš dingir: i am sa ensi.
these are bi statutes u3 judgments tathā laws, yad bi en dù between him ù tad children ak israel ša mount sinai by bi hand sya moses.
tathā tad prabhu spake prati moses, brū,
speak šè tad children sya israel, u3 brū prati tān, when a guruš shall nirmā a singular vow, bi persons shall me šè bi ensi by thy estimation.
api thy estimation shall bhū asya eṣa male tas twenty years old even šè sixty years old, even thy estimation shall me fifty shekels sya silver, after tad shekel ak tad sanctuary.
tathā if idam vṛt a female, then thy estimation shall me thirty shekels.
api if bi bhū tas five years old even šè twenty years old, then thy estimation shall me ak bi male twenty shekels, ca šè bi female ten shekels.
tathā if idam as ta a month old even šè five years old, then thy estimation shall gál sya bi male five shekels ak silver, api mu bi female thy estimation shall vṛt three shekels asya silver.
tathā if bi bhū ta sixty years old tathā ugu; if ne vṛt a male, then thy estimation shall bhū fifteen shekels, ca mu bi female ten shekels.
but if bi as poorer than thy estimation, then ayam shall present himself before tad priest, ca eṣa priest shall value him; according abhimukham asya ability iri vowed shall eṣa priest value him.
api if ne me a beast, whereof men bring an offering šè bi en, gištug iri any lú giveth ak such šè eṣa nātha shall gál holy.
sa shall ul alter bi, nor change ne, a sādhu kṛte a bad, or a bad kṛte a śubha: u3 if eṣa shall at viśva change beast kṛte beast, then ne u3 bi exchange thereof shall gál holy.
u3 if ne gál any unclean beast, asya yaḥ they do ul offer a sacrifice šè sa lugal, then bi shall present bi beast before bi priest:
api bi priest shall value tat, whether ne me dùg or bad: as thou valuest idam, who art sa priest, ga-nam shall bi me.
but if ani will at sakala redeem idam, then ayam shall add a fifth part thereof abhimukham thy estimation.
ca when a nitadam shall sanctify tasya geh abhimukham as holy šè sa nātha, then tad priest shall estimate idam, whether bi gál du10 or bad: as bi priest shall estimate bi, ga-nam shall ne stand.
api if eṣa tad sanctified idam will redeem tasya é, then eṣa shall add bi fifth part asya bi money sya thy estimation šè idam, ù idam shall gál bi.

api if a guruš shall sanctify šè eṣa ensi some part ak a field ak asya possession, then thy estimation shall me according prati eṣa seed thereof: an homer ak barley seed shall as valued at fifty shekels ak silver.
if eṣa sanctify bi field ta eṣa year sya jubile, according abhimukham thy estimation ne shall stand.

but if ani sanctify bi field after sa jubile, then eṣa priest shall reckon šè him sa money according šè bi years yad remain, even abhimukham sa year ak tad jubile, u3 idam shall gál abated tas thy estimation.
u3 if bi yad sanctified bi field will antar any wise redeem ne, then bi shall add sa fifth part sya bi money sya thy estimation abhimukham ne, ù ne shall me assured prati him.
ca if eṣa will na redeem tad field, or if ayam have sold bi field šè another nara, bi shall ul me redeemed any more.
but tad field, when bi goeth bar antar sa jubile, shall as holy prati bi lugal, as a field devoted; bi possession thereof shall as tad priest's.
ù if a puruṣa sanctify prati eṣa ensi a field yad sa hath bought, yad is ul ak bi fields sya bi possession;
then bi priest shall reckon šè him bi worth sya thy estimation, even šè sa year ak tad jubile: u3 bi shall give thine estimation antar ne dina, as a holy thing šè sa lugal.
antar bi year ak bi jubile tad field shall return prati him asya whom idam as bought, even prati him šè whom sa possession ak bi deśa did belong.
ù gištug thy estimations shall vṛt according abhimukham bi shekel asya bi sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall me bi shekel.
only bi firstling sya bi beasts, ša should as sa lord's firstling, nu guruš shall sanctify idam; whether bi gál ox, or sheep: tat is sa lord's.

ù if tat me sya an unclean beast, then ayam shall redeem bi according šè thine estimation, ù shall add a fifth part asya ne thereto: or if ne me ul redeemed, then idam shall bhū sold according abhimukham thy estimation.

notwithstanding nu devoted thing, iri a guruš shall devote šè tad ensi asya sarva tad ayam hath, both asya nara ù beast, tathā asya bi field asya tasya possession, shall gál sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy abhimukham bi ensi.
none devoted, lú shall gál devoted ak men, shall me redeemed; but shall surely vṛt put prati maraṇa.
tathā viśva bi tithe sya bi bhū, whether ak eṣa seed ak bi bhū, or sya bi fruit asya bi tree, is sa lord's: ne is holy prati tad lugal.
u3 if a puruṣa will at niĝ redeem ought ak ani tithes, eṣa shall add thereto bi fifth part thereof.
ca concerning bi tithe asya bi herd, or ak eṣa flock, even ak whatsoever passeth ki-ta tad rod, eṣa tenth shall me holy abhimukham eṣa en.
sa shall na search whether tat gál śubha or bad, neither shall ani change idam: api if ayam change idam at šu, then both tat ca bi change thereof shall as holy; bi shall na as redeemed.
these are tad commandments, yaḥ bi svāmin commanded moses kṛte bi children sya israel antar mount sinai.
